entries.shortAnswer: 「下雨」的英文是 rain，既可作动词也可作名词。注意 rain 多指一般下雨，而 drizzle 指毛毛雨、pour 指倾盆大雨。
entries.definition: rain 作名词不可数，如 heavy rain、light rain；作动词时主语常用 it，如 It's raining。表示进入雨季可说 the rainy season，东亚梅雨常意译为 plum rain season 并加解释。

examples.en: It's raining heavily, so take an umbrella with you.
examples.zh: 雨下得很大，你带把伞吧。

examples.en: The rainy season in East Asia often brings weeks of continuous rain.
examples.zh: 东亚的梅雨季节常常带来连续数周的降雨。

entries.shortAnswer: “rain”的中文意思是「下雨」，常作名词或动词。它泛指降雨，而 drizzle 指毛毛雨，pour 强调倾盆大雨。
entries.definition: rain 作名词不可数，常见搭配有 heavy rain、light rain、acid rain；作动词时通常用 it 作主语，如 It's raining。口语中也可说 It looks like rain 表示天要下雨。

examples.en: It's raining heavily, so take an umbrella with you.
examples.zh: 雨下得很大，你带把伞吧。

examples.en: The rainy season in East Asia often brings weeks of continuous rain.
examples.zh: 东亚的梅雨季节常常带来连续数周的降雨。

entries.shortAnswer: 晴天的英文是 sunny day，指天空无云或少云、阳光充足的日子。注意它强调“天气晴好”，而 clear 更侧重天空无云，不一定有阳光。
entries.definition: 说“今天是个晴天”常用 It's a sunny day 或 It's sunny today。sunny day 是名词短语，可作主语或表语；形容天气好、适合出门时最自然。注意不要用 sun day 表示晴天，那会被理解为“太阳日/星期日”。

examples.en: It's a sunny day, so let's go to the park.
examples.zh: 今天是个晴天，我们去公园吧。

examples.en: We had three sunny days in a row during our trip.
examples.zh: 旅行期间我们连续遇到了三个晴天。

entries.shortAnswer: sunny day 的中文意思是晴天，表示阳光充足、天空少云的日子。它与 fine weather 的区别是更强调阳光明媚，而不只是天气不错。
entries.definition: sunny day 是名词短语，日常口语和书面都常用，如 on a sunny day、a warm sunny day。注意 sunny 已有“晴”义，不要再说 sunny and no clouds；形容人开朗也可用 sunny，如 a sunny smile。

examples.en: It's a sunny day, so let's go to the park.
examples.zh: 今天是个晴天，我们去公园吧。

examples.en: We had three sunny days in a row during our trip.
examples.zh: 旅行期间我们连续遇到了三个晴天。

entries.shortAnswer: 「降温」的英文是 temperature drop，指气温下降，也可说 a drop in temperature。
entries.definition: temperature drop 是名词短语，常与 sharp、sudden 等词连用，如 a sharp temperature drop；也可用动词 drop：Temperatures will drop tonight。注意与 cold snap（寒潮）区分。

examples.en: The weather forecast says there will be a sharp temperature drop tonight, so remember to bring a jacket.
examples.zh: 天气预报说今晚会大幅降温，记得带件外套。

examples.en: A sudden temperature drop in late autumn often catches people off guard, especially during the rainy season.
examples.zh: 深秋的突然降温常常让人措手不及，尤其是在梅雨季节。

entries.shortAnswer: temperature drop 的中文意思是「降温」，指气温下降，强调下降的事实或幅度。
entries.definition: temperature drop 是可数名词短语，常用于天气报道，如 a sudden temperature drop；正式语境可用 drop in temperature，指温度下降的过程或结果，而非持续寒冷。

examples.en: The weather forecast says there will be a sharp temperature drop tonight, so remember to bring a jacket.
examples.zh: 天气预报说今晚会大幅降温，记得带件外套。

examples.en: A sudden temperature drop in late autumn often catches people off guard, especially during the rainy season.
examples.zh: 深秋的突然降温常常让人措手不及，尤其是在梅雨季节。

entries.shortAnswer: 「寒潮」的英文是 cold wave，指强冷空气南下引发的大范围剧烈降温；注意与冷锋（cold front）不同。
entries.definition: cold wave 为可数名词，常见搭配有 a cold wave warning、hit by a cold wave，口语中也可用 a cold snap 表示短促寒潮。

examples.en: A cold wave swept across northern China last week, sending temperatures plunging below minus twenty.
examples.zh: 上周一场寒潮席卷中国北方，气温骤降至零下二十度以下。

examples.en: The weather forecast says a cold wave is on the way, so remember to bundle up.
examples.zh: 天气预报说寒潮即将来袭，记得多穿点。

entries.shortAnswer: Cold wave 中文意思是「寒潮」，指短时间气温骤降的强冷空气过程，与 cold front（冷锋）不同。
entries.definition: Cold wave 指大范围强降温天气，常见搭配有 a cold wave warning、a cold wave swept across the region，口语中多称 cold snap。

examples.en: A cold wave swept across northern China last week, sending temperatures plunging below minus twenty.
examples.zh: 上周一场寒潮席卷中国北方，气温骤降至零下二十度以下。

examples.en: The weather forecast says a cold wave is on the way, so remember to bundle up.
examples.zh: 天气预报说寒潮即将来袭，记得多穿点。

entries.shortAnswer: 「阴天」的英文是 cloudy day，指天空被云层覆盖、少见阳光的天气，通常不下雨。
entries.definition: cloudy day 指多云、天色灰暗的日子，可与 overcast 互换，但后者云层更厚、更书面。常用搭配：on a cloudy day。

examples.en: It was a cloudy day, so we decided to stay indoors and read.
examples.zh: 那是个阴天，所以我们决定待在室内看书。

examples.en: Even on a cloudy day, the park looks beautiful with all the green trees.
examples.zh: 即使是阴天，公园里满眼绿树也依然很美。

entries.shortAnswer: A cloudy day means 阴天 in Chinese: the sky is mostly covered by clouds. It is not a rainy day.
entries.definition: cloudy day 指天空多云的阴天，通常不下雨，语气比 overcast day 更日常。常用搭配：on a cloudy day。

examples.en: It was a cloudy day, so we decided to stay indoors and read.
examples.zh: 那是个阴天，所以我们决定待在室内看书。

examples.en: Even on a cloudy day, the park looks beautiful with all the green trees.
examples.zh: 即使是阴天，公园里满眼绿树也依然很美。

entries.shortAnswer: 「天气预报」的英文是 weather forecast，指对未来天气的预测，常用搭配 check the weather forecast。
entries.definition: weather forecast 指对未来天气的预测，可指预报内容或电视广播中的预报节目。常见搭配：check the weather forecast。

examples.en: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow, so remember to bring an umbrella.
examples.zh: 天气预报说明天会下雨，记得带把伞。

examples.en: I always check the weather forecast before going hiking in the mountains.
examples.zh: 我去山里徒步之前总是会查看天气预报。

entries.shortAnswer: weather forecast 的中文意思是「天气预报」，指对未来天气状况的预测，常见搭配 check the weather forecast。
entries.definition: weather forecast means 天气预报 in Chinese: a prediction of future weather, or the broadcast itself. Common: check the weather forecast。

examples.en: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow, so remember to bring an umbrella.
examples.zh: 天气预报说明天会下雨，记得带把伞。

examples.en: I always check the weather forecast before going hiking in the mountains.
examples.zh: 我去山里徒步之前总是会查看天气预报。

entries.shortAnswer: 三伏天的英文是 dog days（of summer），指北半球夏季最炎热潮湿的一段时期，常与三伏天对应翻译。
entries.definition: dog days 常与 the 连用，如 the dog days of summer；口语中也说 the dog days。注意它不特指农历三伏，而是泛称盛夏酷热期，翻译时多可互换。

examples.en: During the dog days of summer, we stay indoors with the air conditioner on.
examples.zh: 在三伏天里，我们待在室内开着空调。

examples.en: The dog days in this city are so humid that even the evenings feel like a sauna.
examples.zh: 这座城市的三伏天非常潮湿，连傍晚都像蒸桑拿一样。

entries.shortAnswer: Dog days 中文意思是三伏天，指夏季最炎热潮湿的时期。它源自天狼星与太阳同升的古老说法，与汉语按农历计算的三伏天来源不同。
entries.definition: dog days 指北半球七月至八月间的酷热时期，常搭配 the dog days of summer。口语和书面均可用，但不宜直译为“狗的日子”。

examples.en: During the dog days of summer, we stay indoors with the air conditioner on.
examples.zh: 在三伏天里，我们待在室内开着空调。

examples.en: The dog days in this city are so humid that even the evenings feel like a sauna.
examples.zh: 这座城市的三伏天非常潮湿，连傍晚都像蒸桑拿一样。

entries.shortAnswer: 回暖的英文是 warm up，指气温由冷转暖。注意它强调天气变暖的过程，不是形容当天热，别和 warm 混用。
entries.definition: warm up 作不及物动词，主语常是 weather、temperature、spring。例：The weather is warming up. 常见搭配 warm up quickly/again。倒春寒后的回暖也可用 warm up。名词形式是 warming。

examples.en: After the long cold spell, the weather finally started to warm up in late March.
examples.zh: 经过漫长的寒潮，天气终于在三月下旬开始回暖。

examples.en: The forecast says it will warm up by the weekend, so we can eat outside.
examples.zh: 天气预报说周末前会回暖，所以我们可以到户外吃饭。

entries.shortAnswer: warm up 的中文意思是回暖，指天气或气温由冷变暖。它强调变暖的过程，不同于表示状态的 warm 或形容闷热的 humid。
entries.definition: warm up 用于天气时多为不及物，主语是 weather、it 或具体季节，如 It's warming up outside. 口语常用进行时。天预报中常说 It will warm up tomorrow. 注意天气义与运动前热身义不同。

examples.en: After the long cold spell, the weather finally started to warm up in late March.
examples.zh: 经过漫长的寒潮，天气终于在三月下旬开始回暖。

examples.en: The forecast says it will warm up by the weekend, so we can eat outside.
examples.zh: 天气预报说周末前会回暖，所以我们可以到户外吃饭。

entries.shortAnswer: 「下雪」的英文是 snow，可作动词，也可作名词。作动词时主语常用 it，如 It's snowing。
entries.definition: snow 作动词指「下雪」，常用 it 作主语：It snowed all night. 作名词指「雪」，不可数。

examples.en: It snowed heavily last night, so the roads are covered in snow.
examples.zh: 昨晚下了大雪，所以路面上覆盖着积雪。

examples.en: Look, it's snowing outside! The kids are excited to play in the snow.
examples.zh: 快看，外面下雪了！孩子们兴奋地想在雪里玩。

entries.shortAnswer: snow 的中文意思是「下雪」，也可指「雪」。作动词表示雪从天降，作名词指固态降水。
entries.definition: snow 作名词指「雪」，不可数；作动词指「下雪」，主语用 it，如 It snows in winter.

examples.en: It snowed heavily last night, so the roads are covered in snow.
examples.zh: 昨晚下了大雪，所以路面上覆盖着积雪。

examples.en: Look, it's snowing outside! The kids are excited to play in the snow.
examples.zh: 快看，外面下雪了！孩子们兴奋地想在雪里玩。

entries.shortAnswer: 霜冻的英文是 frost，指气温降到冰点以下时，地面或植物表面水汽凝华成白色冰晶的现象。
entries.definition: frost 多作名词，也作动词；常见搭配有 early frost（早霜）、frost damage（霜冻灾害）、hard frost（重霜）。

examples.en: The farmers covered the young plants with plastic to protect them from the frost.
examples.zh: 农民用塑料布盖住幼苗，以保护它们免受霜冻的影响。

examples.en: There was a heavy frost last night, and the whole field turned white this morning.
examples.zh: 昨晚下了重霜，今天早上整片田野都变白了。

entries.shortAnswer: Frost 的中文意思是霜冻，指气温降到冰点以下时，水汽在物体表面凝华成白色冰晶的现象。
entries.definition: frost 指天冷时地面或植物上结的白霜，也可作动词表示结霜；常见搭配：a hard frost、frost on the windows。

examples.en: The farmers covered the young plants with plastic to protect them from the frost.
examples.zh: 农民用塑料布盖住幼苗，以保护它们免受霜冻的影响。

examples.en: There was a heavy frost last night, and the whole field turned white this morning.
examples.zh: 昨晚下了重霜，今天早上整片田野都变白了。

entries.shortAnswer: 「阵风」的英文是 gust，指短时风速突增。注意 gust 是名词，说「一阵大风」用 a gust of wind，不说 a gust wind。
entries.definition: gust 常搭配 a gust of wind 或 strong gust。天气预报里用 gusts of up to 60 km/h 表示阵风时速。与 breeze（微风）不同，gust 强调短暂、突然增强的风。

examples.en: A sudden gust of wind blew my hat off.
examples.zh: 一阵突如其来的阵风把我的帽子吹掉了。

examples.en: The forecast warns of strong gusts up to 70 kilometers per hour.
examples.zh: 天气预报警告有高达每小时七十公里的强阵风。

entries.shortAnswer: Gust 的中文意思是「阵风」，指风速突然短暂增强。它不同于持续稳定的 wind，强调突发性和短时性。
entries.definition: Gust 作名词，常见搭配 a gust of wind、strong gust。天气预报常用 gusts of up to... 表示阵风风速。口语中也可说 a gust of laughter 表示一阵大笑。

examples.en: A sudden gust of wind blew my hat off.
examples.zh: 一阵突如其来的阵风把我的帽子吹掉了。

examples.en: The forecast warns of strong gusts up to 70 kilometers per hour.
examples.zh: 天气预报警告有高达每小时七十公里的强阵风。

entries.shortAnswer: 「气温」的英文是 temperature，指空气的冷热，通常说 the temperature。
entries.definition: temperature 指空气冷热的度数，常搭配 the：the temperature is 30°C。它也指体温、水温等。

examples.en: The temperature dropped below zero last night, so the roads are icy this morning.
examples.zh: 昨晚气温降到了零度以下，所以今天早上路面结冰了。

examples.en: During the plum rain season, the temperature stays high and the air feels muggy.
examples.zh: 梅雨季节里气温一直很高，空气闷热潮湿。

entries.shortAnswer: temperature 指「气温」，即空气的冷热程度，常说 the temperature。
entries.definition: temperature 表示冷热的度数，可指气温、体温、水温。常见搭配：high/low temperature、the temperature drops。

examples.en: The temperature dropped below zero last night, so the roads are icy this morning.
examples.zh: 昨晚气温降到了零度以下，所以今天早上路面结冰了。

examples.en: During the plum rain season, the temperature stays high and the air feels muggy.
examples.zh: 梅雨季节里气温一直很高，空气闷热潮湿。

entries.shortAnswer: 「防晒」的英文是 sunscreen，指防晒霜或防晒产品；日常口语中也常用 sunblock，但 sunscreen 更强调化学吸收紫外线。
entries.definition: sunscreen 多指涂抹的防晒霜，搭配 apply/wear sunscreen；防晒的统称还可用 sun protection，如 sun protection factor（SPF）。注意 umbrella 是遮阳伞，不等于防晒霜。

examples.en: Don't forget to apply sunscreen before you go out; the UV index is really high today.
examples.zh: 出门前别忘了涂防晒，今天的紫外线指数很高。

examples.en: She always carries a bottle of sunscreen in her bag, even on cloudy days.
examples.zh: 她包里总是带着一瓶防晒，即使是阴天也不例外。

entries.shortAnswer: Sunscreen 的中文意思是「防晒」，通常指防晒霜或防晒乳；它和 sunblock 近义，但 sunscreen 更常指化学防晒产品。
entries.definition: sunscreen 是名词，指涂抹于皮肤以防止晒伤的防晒产品，常见搭配 apply/wear/reapply sunscreen。口语中也可说 sun cream；注意它不是遮阳伞（parasol）或防晒衣。

examples.en: Don't forget to apply sunscreen before you go out; the UV index is really high today.
examples.zh: 出门前别忘了涂防晒，今天的紫外线指数很高。

examples.en: She always carries a bottle of sunscreen in her bag, even on cloudy days.
examples.zh: 她包里总是带着一瓶防晒，即使是阴天也不例外。

entries.shortAnswer: 「回南天」的英文是 returning south wind。这是华南春季特有的返潮天气，英文无标准对应词，需解释现象。
entries.definition: 回南天指华南春季冷空气走后暖湿气流北上，墙壁地板「冒水」、衣物难干。说 returning south wind 时最好加解释，如 damp days 或 back-to-south days。

examples.en: During the returning south wind, the walls and floors sweat, and clothes take days to dry.
examples.zh: 回南天时，墙壁和地板冒水，衣服几天都干不了。

examples.en: Spring in southern China often brings the returning south wind, a humid spell that makes everything damp.
examples.zh: 华南的春天常会带来回南天，一段让所有东西都潮湿的返潮期。

entries.shortAnswer: Returning south wind 的中文意思是「回南天」。它特指中国华南春季的返潮天气，不是普通的南风。
entries.definition: Returning south wind 指华南春季暖湿气流回归导致的极端潮湿天气，墙壁地板凝水、衣物不干。日常可说 back-to-south days 或 humid spring days，需加解释。

examples.en: During the returning south wind, the walls and floors sweat, and clothes take days to dry.
examples.zh: 回南天时，墙壁和地板冒水，衣服几天都干不了。

examples.en: Spring in southern China often brings the returning south wind, a humid spell that makes everything damp.
examples.zh: 华南的春天常会带来回南天，一段让所有东西都潮湿的返潮期。

entries.shortAnswer: 雨伞的英文是 umbrella，可数名词，一把伞说 an umbrella。既指雨伞也指遮阳伞，口语常说 take an umbrella。
entries.definition: umbrella 泛指各类伞，英式口语也常用 brolly。搭配：take an umbrella（带伞）、put up an umbrella（撑伞）。

examples.en: It looks like rain, so take an umbrella with you.
examples.zh: 看样子要下雨了，带把伞吧。

examples.en: She put up her umbrella and walked into the rainy season drizzle.
examples.zh: 她撑起雨伞，走进梅雨季的细雨中。

entries.shortAnswer: Umbrella 的中文意思是雨伞，也可指遮阳伞，是撑在头顶挡雨或遮阳的用具，不同于 raincoat。
entries.definition: umbrella 是可数名词，指雨伞或遮阳伞，英式口语也说 brolly。搭配：take an umbrella、put up an umbrella、under an umbrella。

examples.en: It looks like rain, so take an umbrella with you.
examples.zh: 看样子要下雨了，带把伞吧。

examples.en: She put up her umbrella and walked into the rainy season drizzle.
examples.zh: 她撑起雨伞，走进梅雨季的细雨中。

entries.shortAnswer: 「湿度」的英文是 humidity，通常指空气中的水汽含量。注意 humid 是形容词，表示「潮湿的」，而 humidity 是名词，不能混用。
entries.definition: humidity 多用于天气和气候描述，常见搭配有 high/low humidity（湿度高/低）。口语中也常用 humid 形容闷热潮湿的天气，如 It's humid today。

examples.en: The humidity is really high today, so it feels much hotter than the actual temperature.
examples.zh: 今天湿度很高，所以体感温度比实际气温热得多。

examples.en: During the rainy season, the humidity stays above 80% for weeks, making everything feel damp.
examples.zh: 梅雨季节期间，湿度连续几周保持在80%以上，感觉什么东西都潮乎乎的。

entries.shortAnswer: Humidity 的中文意思是「湿度」，指空气中水蒸气的含量。它和 moisture 不同，humidity 专指空气的潮湿程度。
entries.definition: humidity 是名词，常见搭配如 high humidity、relative humidity（相对湿度）。天气预报中常用来描述闷热天气，日常口语也可用 humid 形容词形式。

examples.en: The humidity is really high today, so it feels much hotter than the actual temperature.
examples.zh: 今天湿度很高，所以体感温度比实际气温热得多。

examples.en: During the rainy season, the humidity stays above 80% for weeks, making everything feel damp.
examples.zh: 梅雨季节期间，湿度连续几周保持在80%以上，感觉什么东西都潮乎乎的。

entries.shortAnswer: 「秋老虎」英文常译为 Indian summer，但两者有时间差：秋老虎指立秋（8月）后回热，Indian summer 指深秋（10-11月）的回暖。
entries.definition: Indian summer 多用于北美深秋回暖，常搭配 a brief/late Indian summer；译「秋老虎」时需加时间说明，避免让英语母语者误以为指8月。

examples.en: The weather forecast says we're in for a brief Indian summer before the first frost.
examples.zh: 天气预报说初霜前我们会经历一次短暂的回暖，也就是秋老虎天气。

examples.en: After a week of cold rain, an Indian summer brought warm afternoons back to the town.
examples.zh: 冷雨一周后，一段深秋回暖期让小镇的午后重新暖和起来。

entries.shortAnswer: Indian summer 中文常译作「秋老虎」，但关键区别是时间：Indian summer 指深秋（10-11月）回暖，中文「秋老虎」指立秋（8月）后回热。
entries.definition: Indian summer 指深秋短暂回暖，常见搭配 a late/a brief Indian summer，偏文学口语；也可喻指晚年或事业后期的短暂回春，非正式场合可用。

examples.en: The weather forecast says we're in for a brief Indian summer before the first frost.
examples.zh: 天气预报说初霜前我们会经历一次短暂的回暖，也就是秋老虎天气。

examples.en: After a week of cold rain, an Indian summer brought warm afternoons back to the town.
examples.zh: 冷雨一周后，一段深秋回暖期让小镇的午后重新暖和起来。

entries.shortAnswer: 「雨过天晴」的英文是 clear up after rain，指雨后天空放晴，天气转好。
entries.definition: clear up after rain 强调雨停后云散日出，主语多为 it 或 the sky，如 It will clear up after rain tomorrow。

examples.en: The forecast says it will clear up after rain tomorrow, so we can still go hiking.
examples.zh: 天气预报说明天雨过天晴，所以我们还是可以去徒步。

examples.en: After the storm, it finally cleared up after rain, and a rainbow appeared.
examples.zh: 暴风雨过后，终于雨过天晴，天空出现了一道彩虹。

entries.shortAnswer: clear up after rain 的中文意思是「雨过天晴」，指雨后天空放晴，也可比喻情况好转。
entries.definition: clear up after rain 是天气类动词短语，主语常用 it 或 the sky，多见于天气预报，强调雨后转晴。

examples.en: The forecast says it will clear up after rain tomorrow, so we can still go hiking.
examples.zh: 天气预报说明天雨过天晴，所以我们还是可以去徒步。

examples.en: After the storm, it finally cleared up after rain, and a rainbow appeared.
examples.zh: 暴风雨过后，终于雨过天晴，天空出现了一道彩虹。

entries.shortAnswer: 「梅雨」的英文常说 rainy season，但 rainy season 泛指雨季，特指东亚梅雨时可说 East Asian rainy season 或 plum rain season。
entries.definition: 梅雨指东亚春末夏初的持续阴雨天气，英文常用 rainy season 表示。短语 the rainy season begins/ends，during the rainy season。

examples.en: The rainy season in East Asia usually begins in early June and lasts about a month.
examples.zh: 东亚的梅雨通常从六月初开始，持续约一个月。

examples.en: During the rainy season, it is humid and things easily get moldy, so people often use dehumidifiers.
examples.zh: 梅雨季节空气潮湿，东西容易发霉，所以人们常用除湿机。

entries.shortAnswer: “rainy season”常译为「梅雨」，也泛指雨季。在东亚语境下特指梅雨；热带地区则指雨季。
entries.definition: rainy season 指一年中降雨集中的时期，在东亚常对应梅雨。搭配 during the rainy season，the rainy season starts。

examples.en: The rainy season in East Asia usually begins in early June and lasts about a month.
examples.zh: 东亚的梅雨通常从六月初开始，持续约一个月。

examples.en: During the rainy season, it is humid and things easily get moldy, so people often use dehumidifiers.
examples.zh: 梅雨季节空气潮湿，东西容易发霉，所以人们常用除湿机。

entries.shortAnswer: 倒春寒的英文是 late spring cold snap，指春季回暖后突然出现的持续低温天气。
entries.definition: 倒春寒是汉语特有天气词，英语常意译为 late spring cold snap，也可说 late spring cold spell。切勿直译成 spring cold。

examples.en: A late spring cold snap hit the north last week, and farmers rushed to cover their seedlings.
examples.zh: 上周一场倒春寒袭击了北方，农民们赶紧给幼苗盖上覆盖物。

examples.en: Don't put away your coat yet; a late spring cold snap can still catch us off guard.
examples.zh: 先别把外套收起来，倒春寒还可能让我们措手不及。

entries.shortAnswer: late spring cold snap 的中文意思是倒春寒，指春末回暖后突然来袭、易冻伤作物的低温天气。
entries.definition: late spring cold snap 多用于农业与气象语境，口语也说 a cold spell in late spring。snap 强调突然而猛烈。

examples.en: A late spring cold snap hit the north last week, and farmers rushed to cover their seedlings.
examples.zh: 上周一场倒春寒袭击了北方，农民们赶紧给幼苗盖上覆盖物。

examples.en: Don't put away your coat yet; a late spring cold snap can still catch us off guard.
examples.zh: 先别把外套收起来，倒春寒还可能让我们措手不及。

entries.shortAnswer: 晴转多云 的英文是 partly cloudy，表示天空由晴逐渐转为部分有云，云量通常在25%到50%之间。
entries.definition: partly cloudy 常用于天气预报，云量比 cloudy 少、比 mostly sunny 多。它强调多云状态，而非「转」的变化过程；若要突出转变，可用 becoming partly cloudy。

examples.en: The forecast says it will be partly cloudy this afternoon, so we can still go hiking.
examples.zh: 天气预报说今天下午晴转多云，所以我们还是可以去徒步。

examples.en: It was partly cloudy in the morning, and by noon the sun was completely hidden.
examples.zh: 早上天气晴转多云，到了中午太阳就完全被遮住了。

entries.shortAnswer: partly cloudy 的中文意思是晴转多云，指天空有部分云但仍有阳光，云量约四分之一到一半。
entries.definition: partly cloudy 是天气预报常用词，描述云量中等、仍有较多阳光的天气。常见搭配：It's partly cloudy today、partly cloudy skies。口语中也说 partly sunny。

examples.en: The forecast says it will be partly cloudy this afternoon, so we can still go hiking.
examples.zh: 天气预报说今天下午晴转多云，所以我们还是可以去徒步。

examples.en: It was partly cloudy in the morning, and by noon the sun was completely hidden.
examples.zh: 早上天气晴转多云，到了中午太阳就完全被遮住了。

entries.shortAnswer: 「桑拿天」的英文是 sauna-like heat，形容又闷又热、汗黏在身上的天气，常用于口语和天气报道。
entries.definition: 常与 in / during 搭配，如 in this sauna-like heat。强调湿热闷蒸，不等于普通热或干热。

examples.en: We stayed indoors all afternoon because of the sauna-like heat outside.
examples.zh: 因为外面是桑拿天，我们整个下午都待在室内。

examples.en: The rainy season often brings sauna-like heat to southern China.
examples.zh: 雨季常常给中国南方带来桑拿天。

entries.shortAnswer: sauna-like heat 的中文意思是「桑拿天」，指高温高湿、闷热难耐的天气，常用于口语和天气描述。
entries.definition: 名词短语，核心义为湿热闷蒸的天气。常见搭配：in the sauna-like heat。多用于口语和天气报道，不指干热。

examples.en: We stayed indoors all afternoon because of the sauna-like heat outside.
examples.zh: 因为外面是桑拿天，我们整个下午都待在室内。

examples.en: The rainy season often brings sauna-like heat to southern China.
examples.zh: 雨季常常给中国南方带来桑拿天。

entries.shortAnswer: 「雷阵雨」的英文是 thundershower，指伴有雷电、来去较快的阵性降雨。
entries.definition: thundershower 指短暂、局部的雷阵雨，常发生在夏季午后，常见搭配 scattered thundershowers。

examples.en: The weather forecast says there will be scattered thundershowers this afternoon, so take an umbrella.
examples.zh: 天气预报说今天下午有零星雷阵雨，所以带把伞吧。

examples.en: We got caught in a sudden thundershower on the way home and were soaked through.
examples.zh: 我们在回家路上碰到一场突如其来的雷阵雨，全身都淋透了。

entries.shortAnswer: Thundershower means 「雷阵雨」: a brief rain shower with thunder and lightning.
entries.definition: A thundershower is a short, local rain shower with thunder and lightning, common on summer afternoons.

examples.en: The weather forecast says there will be scattered thundershowers this afternoon, so take an umbrella.
examples.zh: 天气预报说今天下午有零星雷阵雨，所以带把伞吧。

examples.en: We got caught in a sudden thundershower on the way home and were soaked through.
examples.zh: 我们在回家路上碰到一场突如其来的雷阵雨，全身都淋透了。

entries.shortAnswer: 元宵节的英文是 Lantern Festival，指农历正月十五赏花灯的节日。注意别直译成 Yuanxiao Festival，国际通用说法是 Lantern Festival。
entries.definition: 元宵节固定译为 Lantern Festival，强调赏灯习俗；食物“元宵/汤圆”常音译为 tangyuan，不叫 dumpling。常见搭配 celebrate the Lantern Festival、on the Lantern Festival。

examples.en: We usually eat tangyuan and watch the lantern show with our family on the Lantern Festival.
examples.zh: 元宵节我们通常和家人一起吃汤圆、看灯展。

examples.en: The Lantern Festival falls on the fifteenth day of the first lunar month, marking the end of the Spring Festival celebrations.
examples.zh: 元宵节在农历正月十五，标志着春节庆祝活动的结束。

entries.shortAnswer: Lantern Festival 的中文意思是元宵节，即农历正月十五、人们赏灯吃汤圆的节日。它不指一般灯会，而是特指中国农历节日。
entries.definition: Lantern Festival 专指中国元宵节，常搭配 celebrate/hold the Lantern Festival；与 Bon Festival（日本盂兰盆节）、Carnival 不同，指农历正月十五，英文中一般不加 the 首字母不大写。

examples.en: We usually eat tangyuan and watch the lantern show with our family on the Lantern Festival.
examples.zh: 元宵节我们通常和家人一起吃汤圆、看灯展。

examples.en: The Lantern Festival falls on the fifteenth day of the first lunar month, marking the end of the Spring Festival celebrations.
examples.zh: 元宵节在农历正月十五，标志着春节庆祝活动的结束。

entries.shortAnswer: 除夕的英文是 Chinese New Year's Eve，指农历年的最后一天。
entries.definition: Chinese New Year's Eve 指农历年的最后一天，即春节前夜，常搭配年夜饭、守岁等。

examples.en: On Chinese New Year's Eve, families gather for a reunion dinner and stay up late.
examples.zh: 除夕夜，家家户户团聚吃年夜饭，并守岁迎接新年。

examples.en: Many people travel home before Chinese New Year's Eve, so train tickets are hard to get.
examples.zh: 很多人赶在除夕前回家，所以火车票常常很难买。

entries.shortAnswer: Chinese New Year's Eve means 除夕, the last day of the lunar year.
entries.definition: Chinese New Year's Eve is 除夕, the final day of the lunar year, before Spring Festival Day.

examples.en: On Chinese New Year's Eve, families gather for a reunion dinner and stay up late.
examples.zh: 除夕夜，家家户户团聚吃年夜饭，并守岁迎接新年。

examples.en: Many people travel home before Chinese New Year's Eve, so train tickets are hard to get.
examples.zh: 很多人赶在除夕前回家，所以火车票常常很难买。

entries.shortAnswer: 春节的英文常称 Chinese New Year，也叫 Spring Festival，指中国农历新年。
entries.definition: Chinese New Year 是「春节」最通行的英文说法，指中国农历新年；Spring Festival 更直译，常见于国内英文媒体。

examples.en: Millions of people travel home to celebrate Chinese New Year with their families.
examples.zh: 数百万人赶回家与家人一起庆祝春节。

examples.en: During Chinese New Year, children receive lucky money in red envelopes.
examples.zh: 春节期间，孩子们会收到装在红包里的压岁钱。

entries.shortAnswer: Chinese New Year means 春节, the whole Chinese lunar new year holiday, not just one day.
entries.definition: Chinese New Year means 春节, the Chinese lunar new year; it names the whole holiday season, not the single day.

examples.en: Millions of people travel home to celebrate Chinese New Year with their families.
examples.zh: 数百万人赶回家与家人一起庆祝春节。

examples.en: During Chinese New Year, children receive lucky money in red envelopes.
examples.zh: 春节期间，孩子们会收到装在红包里的压岁钱。

entries.shortAnswer: 清明节的英文是 Tomb-Sweeping Day，意为扫墓日，口语中也说 Qingming Festival。
entries.definition: Tomb-Sweeping Day 指清明节，字面意“扫墓日”。常见搭配：sweep the tombs（扫墓）、pay respects to ancestors（祭祖）。

examples.en: During Tomb-Sweeping Day, many Chinese families visit their ancestors' graves to pay respects.
examples.zh: 清明节期间，许多中国家庭会去祖先的墓地祭拜。

examples.en: Tomb-Sweeping Day is a public holiday in China, and people often enjoy spring outings after sweeping the tombs.
examples.zh: 清明节是中国的公共假期，人们扫墓后常常会去春游踏青。

entries.shortAnswer: Tomb-Sweeping Day is 清明节 in Chinese, a traditional festival for honoring ancestors.
entries.definition: Tomb-Sweeping Day means 清明节, a Chinese festival when people sweep tombs and pay respects to ancestors.

examples.en: During Tomb-Sweeping Day, many Chinese families visit their ancestors' graves to pay respects.
examples.zh: 清明节期间，许多中国家庭会去祖先的墓地祭拜。

examples.en: Tomb-Sweeping Day is a public holiday in China, and people often enjoy spring outings after sweeping the tombs.
examples.zh: 清明节是中国的公共假期，人们扫墓后常常会去春游踏青。

entries.shortAnswer: 「沙尘暴」的英文是 sandstorm，指强风卷起大量沙尘、能见度骤降的天气现象。
entries.definition: sandstorm 为可数名词，常与 blow、hit、sweep 等动词搭配，如 a sandstorm hit the city。

examples.en: A sudden sandstorm forced the airport to cancel all flights.
examples.zh: 一场突如其来的沙尘暴迫使机场取消了所有航班。

examples.en: If you're driving through the desert, keep an eye out for sandstorms.
examples.zh: 如果你开车穿越沙漠，要留意沙尘暴。

entries.shortAnswer: Sandstorm 的中文意思是「沙尘暴」，指强风将沙尘吹起、能见度极低的天气。
entries.definition: sandstorm is a countable noun; common collocations include a heavy sandstorm and be caught in a sandstorm.

examples.en: A sudden sandstorm forced the airport to cancel all flights.
examples.zh: 一场突如其来的沙尘暴迫使机场取消了所有航班。

examples.en: If you're driving through the desert, keep an eye out for sandstorms.
examples.zh: 如果你开车穿越沙漠，要留意沙尘暴。

entries.shortAnswer: 中秋节的英文是 Mid-Autumn Festival，这是固定译名，不要直译成 Middle Autumn Day。
entries.definition: Mid-Autumn Festival 是中秋节的标准英文名，首字母大写，常与 the 连用；月饼译为 mooncake。

examples.en: During the Mid-Autumn Festival, families gather together to eat mooncakes and admire the full moon.
examples.zh: 中秋节期间，家人聚在一起吃月饼、赏满月。

examples.en: The Mid-Autumn Festival is one of the most important traditional holidays in China, second only to the Spring Festival.
examples.zh: 中秋节是中国最重要的传统节日之一，重要性仅次于春节。

entries.shortAnswer: Mid-Autumn Festival 的中文意思是中秋节，指中国农历八月十五的传统团圆节日。
entries.definition: Mid-Autumn Festival 是中国农历八月十五的团圆节日，常见搭配有 celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival。

examples.en: During the Mid-Autumn Festival, families gather together to eat mooncakes and admire the full moon.
examples.zh: 中秋节期间，家人聚在一起吃月饼、赏满月。

examples.en: The Mid-Autumn Festival is one of the most important traditional holidays in China, second only to the Spring Festival.
examples.zh: 中秋节是中国最重要的传统节日之一，重要性仅次于春节。

entries.shortAnswer: 端午节的英文是 Dragon Boat Festival，国际最通行的译名，考试与正式场合都用它。
entries.definition: Dragon Boat Festival 是「端午节」的标准译名，因赛龙舟得名，首字母大写。相关词：zongzi 粽子、dragon boat race 赛龙舟。

examples.en: We eat zongzi and watch dragon boat races during the Dragon Boat Festival.
examples.zh: 端午节我们吃粽子、看赛龙舟。

examples.en: The Dragon Boat Festival is a public holiday in China, usually in June.
examples.zh: 端午节是中国的法定假日，通常在六月。

entries.shortAnswer: Dragon Boat Festival 即「端午节」，中国农历五月初五的传统节日，与春节、中秋节并列。
entries.definition: Dragon Boat Festival 指中国端午节，因赛龙舟得名，译名固定，首字母大写。搭配：celebrate the Dragon Boat Festival。

examples.en: We eat zongzi and watch dragon boat races during the Dragon Boat Festival.
examples.zh: 端午节我们吃粽子、看赛龙舟。

examples.en: The Dragon Boat Festival is a public holiday in China, usually in June.
examples.zh: 端午节是中国的法定假日，通常在六月。

entries.shortAnswer: “劳动节”的英文是 Labor Day。美国的劳动节在九月，而中国和多数国家的劳动节在五月一日，对应 International Workers' Day。
entries.definition: 说“五一劳动节”时，常用 May Day 或 International Workers' Day；Labor Day 一般特指美国、加拿大九月的那个节日。写日期、假日安排时可用 Labor Day holiday、Labor Day weekend 等搭配。

examples.en: We're planning a short trip to the lake over Labor Day weekend.
examples.zh: 我们打算在劳动节长周末去湖边小旅行。

examples.en: Many stores hold big sales on Labor Day.
examples.zh: 许多商店在劳动节当天举办大促销。

entries.shortAnswer: Labor Day 的中文意思是“劳动节”。在美国它指九月第一个星期一，不是五月一日的 International Workers' Day。
entries.definition: Labor Day 是美加两国的全国性假日，在九月第一个星期一，标志夏季结束；常搭配 Labor Day weekend、Labor Day sale。注意别和 May Day（五一劳动节）混用。

examples.en: We're planning a short trip to the lake over Labor Day weekend.
examples.zh: 我们打算在劳动节长周末去湖边小旅行。

examples.en: Many stores hold big sales on Labor Day.
examples.zh: 许多商店在劳动节当天举办大促销。

entries.shortAnswer: 压岁钱的英文是 lucky money，也可说 red envelope money 或 New Year's money，指长辈春节给孩子的现金红包。不要直译成 pressure money。
entries.definition: lucky money 特指春节红包里的钱，寓意压祟祈福。常见搭配有 give lucky money、get lucky money；泛指红包本身时可说 red envelope，但强调钱时用 lucky money。

examples.en: My grandparents gave me lucky money in a red envelope on Chinese New Year's Eve.
examples.zh: 除夕夜，爷爷奶奶给了我一个红包，里面装着压岁钱。

examples.en: Children usually receive lucky money from their elders during the Spring Festival.
examples.zh: 春节期间，孩子们通常会从长辈那里收到压岁钱。

entries.shortAnswer: Lucky money 的中文意思是压岁钱，即长辈在春节给孩子装在红包里的现金。它不等于普通 gift money，而是带有压祟祈福寓意的节庆红包。
entries.definition: Lucky money 是春节特有的红包钱，也可说 red envelope money 或 New Year's money。常见搭配有 give/get lucky money；不要按字面误读成“幸运的钱”，它核心是压岁钱。

examples.en: My grandparents gave me lucky money in a red envelope on Chinese New Year's Eve.
examples.zh: 除夕夜，爷爷奶奶给了我一个红包，里面装着压岁钱。

examples.en: Children usually receive lucky money from their elders during the Spring Festival.
examples.zh: 春节期间，孩子们通常会从长辈那里收到压岁钱。

entries.shortAnswer: 国庆节的英文是 National Day，指本国国庆日；说中国国庆时加 China's 更清楚。
entries.definition: National Day 是可数名词，泛指各国国庆；指中国常说 China's National Day。搭配：celebrate National Day、National Day holiday、National Day parade。

examples.en: We watched the National Day parade on TV with the whole family.
examples.zh: 我们全家一起在电视上看了国庆节阅兵。

examples.en: Many people travel during the National Day holiday, so train tickets sell out fast.
examples.zh: 很多人在国庆假期出行，所以火车票很快就卖光了。

entries.shortAnswer: National Day 的中文意思是国庆节，即纪念建国或独立的法定节日；中国国庆节是十月一日。
entries.definition: National Day means 国庆节 in Chinese, a national holiday marking a country's founding or independence. For China, say China's National Day.

examples.en: We watched the National Day parade on TV with the whole family.
examples.zh: 我们全家一起在电视上看了国庆节阅兵。

examples.en: Many people travel during the National Day holiday, so train tickets sell out fast.
examples.zh: 很多人在国庆假期出行，所以火车票很快就卖光了。

entries.shortAnswer: 红包的英文是 red envelope，指内装现金的红色信封。注意，微信和支付宝上发的红包叫 digital red envelope，不是 red bag。
entries.definition: red envelope 是标准译法，春节给压岁钱常说 give red envelopes 或 hand out red envelopes。电子红包用 digital red envelope，动词可用 send a digital red envelope。

examples.en: During Chinese New Year, parents give their children red envelopes with lucky money inside.
examples.zh: 春节期间，父母会给孩子发内装压岁钱的红包。

examples.en: My cousin sent me a digital red envelope on WeChat to celebrate my birthday.
examples.zh: 我表弟在微信上给我发了一个电子红包庆祝生日。

entries.shortAnswer: Red envelope 的中文意思是红包，指内装现金的红色信封。它特指传统红色信封，不泛指礼物或一般信封，区别于 gift card 或 plain envelope。
entries.definition: Red envelope 指中国节日或庆典中装现金的红色信封，常见搭配 give/hand out/receive a red envelope。手机上发的电子红包叫 digital red envelope，口语中也可说 send a red envelope。

examples.en: During Chinese New Year, parents give their children red envelopes with lucky money inside.
examples.zh: 春节期间，父母会给孩子发内装压岁钱的红包。

examples.en: My cousin sent me a digital red envelope on WeChat to celebrate my birthday.
examples.zh: 我表弟在微信上给我发了一个电子红包庆祝生日。

entries.shortAnswer: 拜年的英文是 New Year visit，指春节期间向亲友登门祝贺新年。注意它强调“拜访”这一动作，不是泛指所有新年祝福；线上发祝福一般不说 New Year visit。
entries.definition: New Year visit 多指春节期间走亲访友、上门拜年的活动，常与 pay/make a New Year visit to sb 搭配；也可说 New Year's visit。区别：send New Year greetings 指发祝福，不一定登门。

examples.en: Every Spring Festival, we pay a New Year visit to my grandparents and give them lucky money.
examples.zh: 每年春节，我们都会去给祖父母拜年，并给他们压岁钱。

examples.en: During the holiday, she made a New Year visit to her old friends and wished them good luck.
examples.zh: 假期里，她去给老朋友拜年，祝他们好运。

entries.shortAnswer: New Year visit 的中文意思是拜年，即春节期间到亲友家登门祝贺新年。它强调亲自上门拜访，不只是发消息祝福；发祝福可用 send New Year greetings。
entries.definition: New Year visit 指春节期间走亲访友、上门拜年的行为，正式和口语都可用，常搭配 pay/make a New Year visit to sb。注意：它不等于 New Year's resolution（新年决心）或 New Year greetings（新年祝福）。

examples.en: Every Spring Festival, we pay a New Year visit to my grandparents and give them lucky money.
examples.zh: 每年春节，我们都会去给祖父母拜年，并给他们压岁钱。

examples.en: During the holiday, she made a New Year visit to her old friends and wished them good luck.
examples.zh: 假期里，她去给老朋友拜年，祝他们好运。

entries.shortAnswer: 「粽子」的英文是 zongzi，指端午节吃的一种糯米食物。注意 zongzi 是音译借词，通常直接用，不要翻译成 rice dumpling。
entries.definition: 「粽子」的常用英文是 zongzi，复数形式常见为 zongzi，也可写 zongzis；它用糯米和馅料包在竹叶或芦苇叶里，通常在 Dragon Boat Festival（端午节）吃。最易错的是把它译成 rice dumpling，容易让人以为是无馅的米团。

examples.en: During the Dragon Boat Festival, my family always makes zongzi with bamboo leaves.
examples.zh: 端午节期间，我家总会用竹叶包粽子。

examples.en: Do you prefer sweet zongzi or savory zongzi?
examples.zh: 你更喜欢甜粽子还是咸粽子？

entries.shortAnswer: zongzi 的中文意思是「粽子」，一种用竹叶或芦苇叶包裹糯米和馅料的传统食物。注意它常与端午节（Dragon Boat Festival）关联，不是普通 rice dumpling。
entries.definition: zongzi 是英语中从汉语借入的音译词，指端午节吃的糯米粽；常见搭配有 eat zongzi、make zongzi、sweet/savory zongzi。它比 rice dumpling 更准确，因为后者容易指无馅米团，且馅料可甜可咸。

examples.en: During the Dragon Boat Festival, my family always makes zongzi with bamboo leaves.
examples.zh: 端午节期间，我家总会用竹叶包粽子。

examples.en: Do you prefer sweet zongzi or savory zongzi?
examples.zh: 你更喜欢甜粽子还是咸粽子？

entries.shortAnswer: 「春运」英文常说 Spring Festival travel rush，指春节前后的大规模返乡返程潮。
entries.definition: 用法：可数，常见搭配 during the Spring Festival travel rush；也作 chunyun，指节前节后出行高峰，非节日本身。

examples.en: The Spring Festival travel rush is the largest annual human migration, with billions of trips across the country.
examples.zh: 春运是全球最大规模的年度人口迁徙，全国出行人次达数十亿。

examples.en: Train tickets sell out quickly during the Spring Festival travel rush, so many people book weeks in advance.
examples.zh: 春运期间火车票很快售罄，所以许多人提前几周订票。

entries.shortAnswer: Spring Festival travel rush means 春运, the huge holiday travel peak in China.
entries.definition: Use Spring Festival travel rush for the peak travel around Chinese New Year; countable, also called chunyun, not the festival itself.

examples.en: The Spring Festival travel rush is the largest annual human migration, with billions of trips across the country.
examples.zh: 春运是全球最大规模的年度人口迁徙，全国出行人次达数十亿。

examples.en: Train tickets sell out quickly during the Spring Festival travel rush, so many people book weeks in advance.
examples.zh: 春运期间火车票很快售罄，所以许多人提前几周订票。

entries.shortAnswer: 月饼的英文是 mooncake，它是中秋节的应节糕点，口味有莲蓉、豆沙、五仁等。
entries.definition: mooncake 是可数名词，通常连写成一个词，复数形式为 mooncakes，常搭配 eat mooncakes、a box of mooncakes 等表达。

examples.en: My family always eats mooncakes together while watching the full moon on Mid-Autumn Festival.
examples.zh: 中秋节我们一家人总是一边赏月一边吃月饼。

examples.en: She gave me a box of mooncakes filled with lotus seed paste.
examples.zh: 她送了我一盒莲蓉馅的月饼。

entries.shortAnswer: The English word for 月饼 (mooncake) is mooncake, a pastry eaten during the Mid-Autumn Festival.
entries.definition: Mooncake is a countable noun, usually written as one word, with the plural form mooncakes, as in eat mooncakes or a box of mooncakes.

examples.en: My family always eats mooncakes together while watching the full moon on Mid-Autumn Festival.
examples.zh: 中秋节我们一家人总是一边赏月一边吃月饼。

examples.en: She gave me a box of mooncakes filled with lotus seed paste.
examples.zh: 她送了我一盒莲蓉馅的月饼。

entries.shortAnswer: 「补班」英文是 make-up workday，指调休时把周末改成上班的日子，别和加班混淆。
entries.definition: make-up workday 指为凑长假而把周末调成工作日。常搭配 on a make-up workday，注意与 overtime（加班）区别。

examples.en: Our company has a make-up workday this Saturday to cover the National Day holiday.
examples.zh: 我们公司这周六补班，以弥补国庆假期的调休。

examples.en: Many people complain about make-up workdays because they have to work seven days in a row.
examples.zh: 很多人抱怨补班，因为要连续上班七天。

entries.shortAnswer: A make-up workday is 补班 in Chinese: a weekend moved to a workday to offset a long holiday.
entries.definition: A make-up workday is a weekend day turned into a regular workday so a Chinese holiday can be extended. Not the same as overtime.

examples.en: Our company has a make-up workday this Saturday to cover the National Day holiday.
examples.zh: 我们公司这周六补班，以弥补国庆假期的调休。

examples.en: Many people complain about make-up workdays because they have to work seven days in a row.
examples.zh: 很多人抱怨补班，因为要连续上班七天。

entries.shortAnswer: 「汤圆」英文通常写作 tangyuan，是已被英语词典收录的音译借词，多指元宵节吃的糯米甜馅圆子。
entries.definition: tangyuan 是按拼音整体借入英语的音译词，指糯米做的甜馅汤圆，常与 Lantern Festival 连用。

examples.en: During the Lantern Festival, my family always sits together and eats sweet tangyuan in ginger syrup.
examples.zh: 元宵节那天，我们一家人总会坐在一起，吃泡在姜汤里的甜汤圆。

examples.en: The supermarket sells frozen tangyuan all year round, but they taste best when freshly boiled.
examples.zh: 超市一年四季都卖冷冻汤圆，不过刚煮好的时候味道最好。

entries.shortAnswer: Tangyuan is the Chinese word 汤圆: sweet glutinous rice balls eaten at the Lantern Festival.
entries.definition: Tangyuan are round, chewy balls of glutinous rice flour, often filled with sweet sesame or peanut paste and served in hot syrup.

examples.en: During the Lantern Festival, my family always sits together and eats sweet tangyuan in ginger syrup.
examples.zh: 元宵节那天，我们一家人总会坐在一起，吃泡在姜汤里的甜汤圆。

examples.en: The supermarket sells frozen tangyuan all year round, but they taste best when freshly boiled.
examples.zh: 超市一年四季都卖冷冻汤圆，不过刚煮好的时候味道最好。

entries.shortAnswer: 黄金周的英文是 Golden Week，指中国、日本等国的连续长假，属于固定专有名词。
entries.definition: Golden Week 源自日本，现多指中国国庆、春节等连休假期，常见搭配有 during the Golden Week。

examples.en: Millions of people travel during the National Day Golden Week every year.
examples.zh: 每年国庆黄金周期间，数百万人出行旅游。

examples.en: Hotel prices usually rise sharply during Golden Week.
examples.zh: 黄金周期间酒店价格通常大幅上涨。

entries.shortAnswer: Golden Week means 黄金周, a week-long national holiday in China and Japan, and it is a proper noun.
entries.definition: Golden Week is a proper noun for multi-day holidays like China's National Day, often used as during Golden Week.

examples.en: Millions of people travel during the National Day Golden Week every year.
examples.zh: 每年国庆黄金周期间，数百万人出行旅游。

examples.en: Hotel prices usually rise sharply during Golden Week.
examples.zh: 黄金周期间酒店价格通常大幅上涨。

entries.shortAnswer: 「带薪假」英文是 paid leave，指休假期间工资照发的假期，与全民公休日不同。
entries.definition: paid leave 常见于劳动法与公司制度，如 annual paid leave、paid maternity leave，口语也说 PTO，勿与 public holiday 混用。

examples.en: She is on paid leave for two weeks after giving birth.
examples.zh: 她生完孩子后正在休两周带薪假。

examples.en: The company offers twenty days of paid leave per year.
examples.zh: 公司每年提供二十天带薪假。

entries.shortAnswer: paid leave 的中文意思是「带薪假」，指休假期间工资照发的假期，不同于全民公休日。
entries.definition: paid leave 是正式用语，见于劳动合同与政策，如 annual paid leave、paid maternity leave，美式口语常说 PTO。

examples.en: She is on paid leave for two weeks after giving birth.
examples.zh: 她生完孩子后正在休两周带薪假。

examples.en: The company offers twenty days of paid leave per year.
examples.zh: 公司每年提供二十天带薪假。

entries.shortAnswer: 「跨年」的英文常说是 New Year countdown，指倒计时迎接新年的那一刻。也可说 New Year's Eve celebration，但别直译成 cross the year。
entries.definition: New Year countdown 强调新年到来前的倒数计时，常与 watch、join、do 连用。若指整晚聚会或晚会，用 New Year's Eve party 更自然。

examples.en: We stayed up late to watch the New Year countdown on TV.
examples.zh: 我们熬夜看电视上的跨年倒计时。

examples.en: Thousands of people gathered in the square for the New Year countdown.
examples.zh: 成千上万的人聚集在广场上参加跨年倒计时活动。

entries.shortAnswer: New Year countdown 的中文意思是「跨年」，即新年到来前一起倒数计时。它只指倒计时这一环节，不等于整晚的跨年晚会。
entries.definition: New Year countdown 指12月31日午夜前倒数读秒迎接新年的活动，常用于 watch/join/do the New Year countdown。口语也可说 count down to the new year。

examples.en: We stayed up late to watch the New Year countdown on TV.
examples.zh: 我们熬夜看电视上的跨年倒计时。

examples.en: Thousands of people gathered in the square for the New Year countdown.
examples.zh: 成千上万的人聚集在广场上参加跨年倒计时活动。

entries.shortAnswer: 「团圆饭」的英文是 family reunion dinner，指一家人聚在一起吃的那顿丰盛晚餐。它多用于除夕年夜饭，也可泛指中秋等节日家人团聚的饭局。
entries.definition: 固定说法是 family reunion dinner，常与 have/eat 连用，如 have a family reunion dinner。年夜饭也可说 Chinese New Year's Eve dinner，强调“除夕”时更准确。

examples.en: On Chinese New Year's Eve, my whole family gets together for a big family reunion dinner.
examples.zh: 除夕那天，我们全家聚在一起吃一顿丰盛的年夜团圆饭。

examples.en: Even though we live in different cities, we always go home for the family reunion dinner.
examples.zh: 虽然我们住在不同的城市，但每年都会回家吃团圆饭。

entries.shortAnswer: family reunion dinner 的中文意思是「团圆饭」，指全家人团聚时一起吃的一顿正式晚餐。它与普通 dinner 的区别在于强调“团聚”这一节日含义。
entries.definition: family reunion dinner 是名词短语，常见搭配 have/hold a family reunion dinner。多指除夕年夜饭，也可指中秋等节日聚餐，语气偏正式、书面。

examples.en: On Chinese New Year's Eve, my whole family gets together for a big family reunion dinner.
examples.zh: 除夕那天，我们全家聚在一起吃一顿丰盛的年夜团圆饭。

examples.en: Even though we live in different cities, we always go home for the family reunion dinner.
examples.zh: 虽然我们住在不同的城市，但每年都会回家吃团圆饭。

entries.shortAnswer: 「春联」的英文是 Spring Festival couplets，指春节贴在门上的红色成对对联。
entries.definition: 常用搭配：put up / paste up Spring Festival couplets（贴春联）、write Spring Festival couplets（写春联）。

examples.en: Every New Year's Eve, my family puts up Spring Festival couplets on both sides of the front door.
examples.zh: 每年除夕，我们家都会在大门两侧贴上春联。

examples.en: Grandpa wrote the Spring Festival couplets himself, using gold ink on red paper.
examples.zh: 春联是爷爷亲手写的，用的是红纸和金墨。

entries.shortAnswer: Spring Festival couplets 的意思是「春联」，即春节期间贴在门框上的红色成对对联。
entries.definition: Chinese New Year couplets 是常见同义说法，口语也简称 couplets；搭配 put up / write Spring Festival couplets。

examples.en: Every New Year's Eve, my family puts up Spring Festival couplets on both sides of the front door.
examples.zh: 每年除夕，我们家都会在大门两侧贴上春联。

examples.en: Grandpa wrote the Spring Festival couplets himself, using gold ink on red paper.
examples.zh: 春联是爷爷亲手写的，用的是红纸和金墨。

entries.shortAnswer: 灯谜的英文是 lantern riddle，指写在灯笼上供人猜测的谜语，元宵节常见。注意不要与字面直译的 riddles on lanterns 混淆，后者不强调猜谜活动。
entries.definition: Lantern riddle 是元宵节猜灯谜活动的标准英文说法，动词常用 solve/guess a lantern riddle，搭配 lantern riddles 指多个谜语。节日名译法惯例：元宵节为 Lantern Festival，与灯谜紧密相关。

examples.en: During the Lantern Festival, people gather to solve lantern riddles written on colorful lanterns.
examples.zh: 元宵节期间，人们聚在一起猜写在彩色灯笼上的灯谜。

examples.en: She won a small prize by correctly guessing a lantern riddle about a Chinese character.
examples.zh: 她猜中了一个关于汉字的灯谜，赢得了一个小奖品。

entries.shortAnswer: lantern riddle 的中文意思是“灯谜”，即写在灯笼上供人猜测的谜语。与一般 riddle 不同，lantern riddle 特指元宵节期间的传统猜谜活动。
entries.definition: Lantern riddle 指元宵节时写在灯笼上供人猜测的谜语，常见搭配 solve/guess a lantern riddle，为文化专有名词。正式场合可用，口语中也可直接说 lantern riddle。易错点：不要误用为 riddles on lanterns。

examples.en: During the Lantern Festival, people gather to solve lantern riddles written on colorful lanterns.
examples.zh: 元宵节期间，人们聚在一起猜写在彩色灯笼上的灯谜。

examples.en: She won a small prize by correctly guessing a lantern riddle about a Chinese character.
examples.zh: 她猜中了一个关于汉字的灯谜，赢得了一个小奖品。

entries.shortAnswer: 「舞龙舞狮」英文常说 dragon and lion dance，是节庆中的传统表演。
entries.definition: dragon and lion dance 是「舞龙舞狮」的常用译法，dragon dance 指舞龙，lion dance 指舞狮。

examples.en: Every Spring Festival, the village performs a dragon and lion dance.
examples.zh: 每年春节，村里都会表演舞龙舞狮。

examples.en: Tourists watched the dragon and lion dance in the square.
examples.zh: 游客们在广场上观看舞龙舞狮。

entries.shortAnswer: Dragon and lion dance means 舞龙舞狮, a festive Chinese performance.
entries.definition: Dragon and lion dance is the usual English for 舞龙舞狮: the dragon dance plus the lion dance, seen at festivals.

examples.en: Every Spring Festival, the village performs a dragon and lion dance.
examples.zh: 每年春节，村里都会表演舞龙舞狮。

examples.en: Tourists watched the dragon and lion dance in the square.
examples.zh: 游客们在广场上观看舞龙舞狮。

entries.shortAnswer: 「打喷嚏」的英文是 sneeze，既可作动词也可作名词。注意它不是指过敏或感冒本身，而是描述这个动作或声音。
entries.definition: sneeze 作动词时常见搭配 sneeze loudly、sneeze into a tissue；作名词时常用 have a sneeze、a loud sneeze。就医时医生可能问 Do you sneeze a lot? 与 cough（咳嗽）常一起出现。

examples.en: Cover your mouth when you sneeze to avoid spreading germs.
examples.zh: 打喷嚏时捂住嘴，以免传播细菌。

examples.en: I started to sneeze and my eyes were itchy, so the doctor said it was an allergy.
examples.zh: 我开始打喷嚏，眼睛也痒，所以医生说这是过敏。

entries.shortAnswer: Sneeze 的中文意思是「打喷嚏」，指突然从鼻子和嘴巴猛烈喷出空气的动作或声音。它不同于 cough，咳嗽主要从喉咙和胸部用力。
entries.definition: sneeze 可作动词和名词。常见搭配：sneeze into a tissue（对着纸巾打喷嚏）、sneeze loudly；名词形式如 a sneeze。就医时描述症状常与 runny nose、itchy eyes 一起出现。

examples.en: Cover your mouth when you sneeze to avoid spreading germs.
examples.zh: 打喷嚏时捂住嘴，以免传播细菌。

examples.en: I started to sneeze and my eyes were itchy, so the doctor said it was an allergy.
examples.zh: 我开始打喷嚏，眼睛也痒，所以医生说这是过敏。

entries.shortAnswer: 「庙会」的英文是 “temple fair”。在向外国朋友介绍时，直接说 temple fair 即可，不要自造 “temple meeting” 等说法。
entries.definition: temple fair 指在寺庙周边定期举办的集市与民俗活动，常见搭配有 visit a temple fair、at the temple fair；注意不要把“庙会”直译成 temple gathering 或 temple market。

examples.en: Every Spring Festival, my grandparents take me to the temple fair near the old temple to eat snacks and watch folk performances.
examples.zh: 每年春节，我爷爷奶奶都会带我去老寺庙附近的庙会吃小吃、看民俗表演。

examples.en: The temple fair was crowded with visitors buying handicrafts and enjoying traditional opera.
examples.zh: 庙会上挤满了购买手工艺品和欣赏传统戏曲的游客。

entries.shortAnswer: “Temple fair”的中文意思是“庙会”。它通常指在寺庙附近举行的传统集市和民俗节庆活动，不等于普通的“集市” market。
entries.definition: temple fair 是可数名词，常见搭配为 go to a temple fair、during the temple fair；口语中可泛指有传统表演和小吃的节庆集市，正式场合多用于介绍中国民俗文化。

examples.en: Every Spring Festival, my grandparents take me to the temple fair near the old temple to eat snacks and watch folk performances.
examples.zh: 每年春节，我爷爷奶奶都会带我去老寺庙附近的庙会吃小吃、看民俗表演。

examples.en: The temple fair was crowded with visitors buying handicrafts and enjoying traditional opera.
examples.zh: 庙会上挤满了购买手工艺品和欣赏传统戏曲的游客。

entries.shortAnswer: 「流鼻血」的英文是 nosebleed。就医时说 I have a nosebleed 即可，注意别按中文直译成 flow blood from nose。
entries.definition: nosebleed 是可数名词，常用 have/get a nosebleed 表示流鼻血；就医时医生会问是否 frequent（频繁），并可能建议 pinch the nose 止血或 use a nasal spray。

examples.en: He got a nosebleed during the dry winter and had to pinch his nose for a few minutes.
examples.zh: 干燥的冬天他流鼻血了，只得捏住鼻子几分钟。

examples.en: If you have a nosebleed that won't stop, you should see a doctor.
examples.zh: 如果流鼻血止不住，你应该去看医生。

entries.shortAnswer: Nosebleed 的意思是「流鼻血」，指鼻腔出血。它与 bloody nose 近义，但 nosebleed 更常用作医学或日常说法。
entries.definition: nosebleed 是可数名词，常见搭配 have/get a nosebleed；口语中也说 bloody nose。医学上分 anterior（前部）和 posterior（后部）鼻出血，严重时需就医。

examples.en: He got a nosebleed during the dry winter and had to pinch his nose for a few minutes.
examples.zh: 干燥的冬天他流鼻血了，只得捏住鼻子几分钟。

examples.en: If you have a nosebleed that won't stop, you should see a doctor.
examples.zh: 如果流鼻血止不住，你应该去看医生。

entries.shortAnswer: 「发烧」的英文是 have a fever，指体温升高。注意 fever 常搭配 have 或 run，轻微发热可说 have a slight fever。
entries.definition: have a fever 用于描述发烧，口语和书面均可；高热说 have a high fever，退烧常用 reduce the fever。

examples.en: The child has a fever, so the doctor told him to take some medicine and rest.
examples.zh: 孩子发烧了，所以医生让他吃点药并休息。

examples.en: If you have a high fever for more than two days, you should go to the hospital and get an injection.
examples.zh: 如果你发高烧超过两天，就应该去医院打针。

entries.shortAnswer: have a fever 的中文意思是「发烧」，指体温高于正常。常与 high、slight 连用，如 have a high fever。
entries.definition: have a fever 是描述发烧的常用搭配，口语和医学语境均可使用；低热说 have a slight fever，退烧常用 reduce the fever。

examples.en: The child has a fever, so the doctor told him to take some medicine and rest.
examples.zh: 孩子发烧了，所以医生让他吃点药并休息。

examples.en: If you have a high fever for more than two days, you should go to the hospital and get an injection.
examples.zh: 如果你发高烧超过两天，就应该去医院打针。

entries.shortAnswer: 「头晕」的英文是 dizzy，常指天旋地转或站立不稳的感觉。注意 dizzy 多描述自身感受，别与表示「迷茫」的 confused 或「昏倒」的 faint 混用。
entries.definition: dizzy 可作形容词，常见搭配 feel dizzy、get dizzy、a dizzy spell（一阵头晕）。就医时还可说 I feel lightheaded 表示「头重脚轻、眼前发黑」，与眩晕 vertigo 所指的旋转感不同。

examples.en: I felt dizzy after taking the painkiller on an empty stomach.
examples.zh: 我空腹吃了止痛药后感到头晕。

examples.en: If you get dizzy while standing up, sit down and tell the nurse before getting an injection.
examples.zh: 如果你站起来时头晕，先坐下，并在打针前告诉护士。

entries.shortAnswer: dizzy 的中文意思是「头晕」，指感觉天旋地转或站立不稳。它强调自身眩晕感，不等于昏倒（faint），也不等于一般的困惑（confused）。
entries.definition: dizzy 是形容词，用于 feel/get dizzy、a dizzy spell 等搭配，口语和书面均常用。医学上更精确的「眩晕」是 vertigo，而 lightheaded 偏指头重脚轻、快晕倒的感觉。

examples.en: I felt dizzy after taking the painkiller on an empty stomach.
examples.zh: 我空腹吃了止痛药后感到头晕。

examples.en: If you get dizzy while standing up, sit down and tell the nurse before getting an injection.
examples.zh: 如果你站起来时头晕，先坐下，并在打针前告诉护士。

entries.shortAnswer: 流鼻涕的英文是 runny nose，指鼻子不断流出清鼻涕，注意是鼻子在流，别说成 running nose。
entries.definition: 常用搭配 have a runny nose、a runny nose and sneezing。感冒时更常说 I have a runny nose，而不是 I am runny nose。

examples.en: I have a runny nose and a sore throat, so I'll take some cold medicine and get some rest.
examples.zh: 我流鼻涕还嗓子疼，所以打算吃点感冒药休息一下。

examples.en: If your runny nose lasts more than a week, see a doctor instead of buying more painkillers.
examples.zh: 如果流鼻涕持续一周以上，就该去看医生，而不是继续买止痛药。

entries.shortAnswer: Runny nose 的中文意思是流鼻涕，指鼻腔分泌物增多、清鼻涕不断流出，和鼻塞正好相反。
entries.definition: 口语中最常用的说法，搭配 have a runny nose、a runny nose and a sore throat，多指感冒或过敏引起的清水样鼻涕。

examples.en: I have a runny nose and a sore throat, so I'll take some cold medicine and get some rest.
examples.zh: 我流鼻涕还嗓子疼，所以打算吃点感冒药休息一下。

examples.en: If your runny nose lasts more than a week, see a doctor instead of buying more painkillers.
examples.zh: 如果流鼻涕持续一周以上，就该去看医生，而不是继续买止痛药。

entries.shortAnswer: 「嗓子疼」用英语说是 sore throat，常说 I have a sore throat 或 My throat hurts。
entries.definition: sore throat 指咽喉疼痛，多由感冒、流感或过度用嗓引起。常见搭配：have a sore throat、a bad sore throat、throat lozenges。

examples.en: I have a sore throat, so I bought some lozenges.
examples.zh: 我嗓子疼，所以买了些润喉糖。

examples.en: If your sore throat gets worse, you should see a doctor.
examples.zh: 如果你的嗓子疼加重，应该去看医生。

entries.shortAnswer: 「sore throat」的中文意思是「嗓子疼」，指咽喉疼痛、发炎，常伴随吞咽不适。
entries.definition: sore throat 指咽喉疼痛发炎，常由感冒或流感引起，也可能因说话过多或干燥导致。搭配：have a sore throat。

examples.en: I have a sore throat, so I bought some lozenges.
examples.zh: 我嗓子疼，所以买了些润喉糖。

examples.en: If your sore throat gets worse, you should see a doctor.
examples.zh: 如果你的嗓子疼加重，应该去看医生。

entries.shortAnswer: 「打针」的英文是 get an injection，强调接受注射这一动作；口语中也常用 have a shot，但 shot 在美式英语里更随意。
entries.definition: get an injection 是「打针」最通用的说法，侧重接受注射；英式英语常说 have an injection，美式口语常用 get a shot。注意：打针不说 take an injection，吃药才用 take medicine。

examples.en: The nurse gave me an injection in the arm, and I didn't even feel it.
examples.zh: 护士在我胳膊上打了一针，我甚至没感觉到。

examples.en: If the fever doesn't go down, you may need to get an injection at the clinic.
examples.zh: 如果烧不退，你可能需要去诊所打一针。

entries.shortAnswer: 「get an injection」的中文意思是「打针」，指接受药物注射；比 have a shot 稍正式，后者更口语化。
entries.definition: get an injection 意为「打针」，指接受注射，常用于医疗场合；同义 have a shot 更口语（尤美式）。注意：吃药是 take medicine，不是 eat medicine；打针不用 take an injection。

examples.en: The nurse gave me an injection in the arm, and I didn't even feel it.
examples.zh: 护士在我胳膊上打了一针，我甚至没感觉到。

examples.en: If the fever doesn't go down, you may need to get an injection at the clinic.
examples.zh: 如果烧不退，你可能需要去诊所打一针。

entries.shortAnswer: 便秘的英文是 constipation，指排便困难或次数减少，不是拉肚子 diarrhea，描述症状时注意区分。
entries.definition: constipation 多作不可数名词，常说 suffer from constipation、relieve constipation、chronic constipation；缓解便秘可用 laxative（泻药）。

examples.en: If you have constipation for more than a week, you should see a doctor.
examples.zh: 如果你便秘超过一周，就应该去看医生。

examples.en: Drinking more water and eating more fiber can help relieve constipation.
examples.zh: 多喝水和多吃纤维有助于缓解便秘。

entries.shortAnswer: Constipation 的中文意思是便秘，指排便困难、次数减少或粪便干硬，与 diarrhea（腹泻）相反。
entries.definition: constipation 是不可数名词，常搭配 suffer from、relieve、chronic；口语也说 be constipated。注意与 diarrhea（腹泻）区分。

examples.en: If you have constipation for more than a week, you should see a doctor.
examples.zh: 如果你便秘超过一周，就应该去看医生。

examples.en: Drinking more water and eating more fiber can help relieve constipation.
examples.zh: 多喝水和多吃纤维有助于缓解便秘。

entries.shortAnswer: 「消化不良」的英文是 indigestion，指胃部不适、消化困难，是不可数名词。
entries.definition: indigestion 常与 have、get、suffer from 搭配，如 have indigestion（消化不良）。它侧重胃部灼热、胀气等症状，不是具体疾病名。

examples.en: I ate too much spicy food and got indigestion.
examples.zh: 我吃了太多辛辣食物，结果消化不良了。

examples.en: She often suffers from indigestion after heavy meals.
examples.zh: 她在大吃一顿后经常消化不良。

entries.shortAnswer: Indigestion means 消化不良 in Chinese: stomach discomfort from difficulty digesting food.
entries.definition: Indigestion is an uncountable noun for stomach discomfort, often after eating. Say have indigestion; formally, dyspepsia.

examples.en: I ate too much spicy food and got indigestion.
examples.zh: 我吃了太多辛辣食物，结果消化不良了。

examples.en: She often suffers from indigestion after heavy meals.
examples.zh: 她在大吃一顿后经常消化不良。

entries.shortAnswer: 落枕的英文是 crick in the neck，指睡姿不当或受凉后颈部肌肉痉挛僵硬，医生问诊常说 I woke up with a crick in my neck。
entries.definition: crick in the neck 多指晨起后颈部僵硬疼痛、转头受限，属口语表达，搭配 get/have a crick in the neck；颈椎病等慢性问题说 neck pain。

examples.en: I woke up with a crick in my neck and could barely turn my head.
examples.zh: 我落枕了，脖子几乎转不动。

examples.en: She got a crick in the neck from sleeping in a draft, so she put a warm towel on it.
examples.zh: 她因为吹着风睡觉落枕了，所以用热毛巾敷了敷。

entries.shortAnswer: A crick in the neck 的意思是落枕，即睡醒后脖子僵硬疼痛、转动不便，多因睡姿不当或受凉引起。
entries.definition: crick in the neck 为口语说法，指颈部肌肉痉挛造成的急性僵硬疼痛，常见搭配 get/have a crick in the neck、wake up with a crick。

examples.en: I woke up with a crick in my neck and could barely turn my head.
examples.zh: 我落枕了，脖子几乎转不动。

examples.en: She got a crick in the neck from sleeping in a draft, so she put a warm towel on it.
examples.zh: 她因为吹着风睡觉落枕了，所以用热毛巾敷了敷。

entries.shortAnswer: 「创可贴」的英文最常见说法是 band-aid，英式英语中也常说 plaster。注意 Band-Aid 本是美国强生公司的注册商标，泛指时小写即可，口语里可数。
entries.definition: band-aid 指贴在伤口上的小敷料，口语中引申为「临时补救措施」。美式多用 band-aid，英式常用 plaster，正式场合也说 adhesive bandage。

examples.en: He cut his finger while cooking and put a band-aid on it.
examples.zh: 他做饭时切到了手指，贴了一张创可贴。

examples.en: The new tax cut is just a band-aid for the country's economic problems.
examples.zh: 新的减税政策只是对国家经济问题的临时补救措施。

entries.shortAnswer: band-aid 的中文意思是「创可贴」，指贴在伤口上的小敷料。它本是美国强生公司的商标，泛指时小写；英式英语中对应常用词是 plaster。
entries.definition: band-aid 作名词指创可贴，美式口语常用，可引申为「临时补救办法」；英式英语更常说 plaster，正式语境可用 adhesive bandage。

examples.en: He cut his finger while cooking and put a band-aid on it.
examples.zh: 他做饭时切到了手指，贴了一张创可贴。

examples.en: The new tax cut is just a band-aid for the country's economic problems.
examples.zh: 新的减税政策只是对国家经济问题的临时补救措施。

entries.shortAnswer: 「吃药」的英文是 take medicine，不是 eat medicine；服药强调按时按量吞服，take 在此表示服用。
entries.definition: take medicine 是固定搭配，指按医嘱或说明书服用药物，适用于日常和医疗场合；take your medicine 还引申为承担后果、自食其果。

examples.en: The doctor told me to take medicine three times a day after meals.
examples.zh: 医生让我每天饭后吃这个药，一天三次。

examples.en: If you have a fever, take medicine and get some rest.
examples.zh: 如果你发烧，就吃点药，然后好好休息。

entries.shortAnswer: take medicine 的中文意思是「吃药」，指按时按量服下药物，与 eat 无关，强调服用动作。
entries.definition: take medicine 是英语固定搭配，表示服药，常用于医嘱和日常表达；take your medicine 另有接受惩罚或自食其果之义。

examples.en: The doctor told me to take medicine three times a day after meals.
examples.zh: 医生让我每天饭后吃这个药，一天三次。

examples.en: If you have a fever, take medicine and get some rest.
examples.zh: 如果你发烧，就吃点药，然后好好休息。

entries.shortAnswer: 「开药」用英语说是 prescribe medication，也可简说 prescribe。
entries.definition: prescribe medication 指医生为患者开具处方药。主语是医生，患者是 receive a prescription；取药说 fill a prescription。

examples.en: The doctor prescribed medication to bring down my fever and told me to rest.
examples.zh: 医生给我开药退烧，并让我休息。

examples.en: If your side effects get worse, the doctor may prescribe medication to help you sleep.
examples.zh: 如果你的副作用加重，医生可能会开药帮助你入睡。

entries.shortAnswer: Prescribe medication 的中文意思是「开药」，指医生为患者开具药物处方。
entries.definition: prescribe medication 是医疗场景的标准搭配，主语通常是医生。患者是 receive a prescription，取药说 fill a prescription。

examples.en: The doctor prescribed medication to bring down my fever and told me to rest.
examples.zh: 医生给我开药退烧，并让我休息。

examples.en: If your side effects get worse, the doctor may prescribe medication to help you sleep.
examples.zh: 如果你的副作用加重，医生可能会开药帮助你入睡。

entries.shortAnswer: 「输液」英文是 IV drip，即静脉滴注，也常说 put someone on an IV drip。
entries.definition: IV drip 指静脉滴注，常搭配 be on an IV drip 或 put someone on an IV drip。注意：打针是 get an injection，吃药是 take medicine，不能说 eat medicine。

examples.en: The doctor put her on an IV drip to treat the severe dehydration.
examples.zh: 医生给她输液以治疗严重的脱水。

examples.en: In many Chinese hospitals, patients with minor illnesses receive an IV drip, while in the US they are usually given oral medicine.
examples.zh: 在中国许多医院，轻症患者也会输液，而在美国通常只给口服药。

entries.shortAnswer: IV drip 对应中文「输液」，即静脉滴注，常搭配 be on an IV drip 或 put someone on an IV drip。
entries.definition: IV drip 是 intravenous drip 的缩写，指通过静脉持续滴注药液或营养液，口语中也可说 IV。注意与 injection（打针）区别：injection 是推注，IV drip 是滴注。

examples.en: The doctor put her on an IV drip to treat the severe dehydration.
examples.zh: 医生给她输液以治疗严重的脱水。

examples.en: In many Chinese hospitals, patients with minor illnesses receive an IV drip, while in the US they are usually given oral medicine.
examples.zh: 在中国许多医院，轻症患者也会输液，而在美国通常只给口服药。

entries.shortAnswer: 「痊愈」的英文是 fully recovered，指完全恢复健康，比 get better 更强调彻底康复。
entries.definition: fully recovered 指病后或术后完全康复，常作表语：be fully recovered from an illness。

examples.en: After two weeks of rest and medicine, she was fully recovered from the flu.
examples.zh: 休息并吃药两周后，她流感痊愈了。

examples.en: The doctor said I would be fully recovered within a month after the surgery.
examples.zh: 医生说手术后一个月内我就会痊愈。

entries.shortAnswer: fully recovered 的中文意思是「痊愈」，指完全恢复健康，强调彻底康复而非仅仅好转。
entries.definition: fully recovered 指病后或术后完全康复，常作表语：be fully recovered from…，强调「完全」。

examples.en: After two weeks of rest and medicine, she was fully recovered from the flu.
examples.zh: 休息并吃药两周后，她流感痊愈了。

examples.en: The doctor said I would be fully recovered within a month after the surgery.
examples.zh: 医生说手术后一个月内我就会痊愈。

entries.shortAnswer: 「复发」的英文是 relapse；通常用于疾病好转后再次发作，也可指戒瘾后复吸或旧习重现。
entries.definition: relapse 常作名词或不及物动词，多指病情、毒瘾、酒瘾等好转后又回到原来的状态；医学语境里强调“再次发作”。搭配如 relapse of the disease、relapse into drinking。

examples.en: The patient relapsed after stopping the medication too early.
examples.zh: 病人过早停药后病情复发了。

examples.en: Stress and lack of sleep can increase the risk of a relapse.
examples.zh: 压力和睡眠不足会增加复发风险。

entries.shortAnswer: Relapse 的中文意思是「复发」；常指疾病好转后再次发作，或戒瘾后重新吸食、饮酒。
entries.definition: relapse 可作名词或动词，强调病愈或戒断后再次回到原先的病症或不良状态。常见搭配有 relapse of the illness、relapse into addiction。与 recurrence 相比，relapse 更侧重“旧病/旧瘾重来”。

examples.en: The patient relapsed after stopping the medication too early.
examples.zh: 病人过早停药后病情复发了。

examples.en: Stress and lack of sleep can increase the risk of a relapse.
examples.zh: 压力和睡眠不足会增加复发风险。

entries.shortAnswer: 「拔罐」英文是 cupping therapy，口语常简称 cupping，如 get cupping therapy。
entries.definition: cupping therapy 指用负压把罐吸附在皮肤上的中医疗法，常见搭配 receive cupping therapy、cupping marks（罐印）。

examples.en: After the marathon, she tried cupping therapy to relieve her tight back muscles, leaving round purple marks on her shoulders.
examples.zh: 马拉松之后，她尝试了拔罐来缓解背部肌肉紧绷，肩上留下了圆圆的紫色罐印。

examples.en: Many people first heard of cupping therapy during the Olympics, when swimmers with circular bruises went viral online.
examples.zh: 很多人第一次听说拔罐是在奥运会期间，当时背上带着圆形瘀印的游泳运动员在网上走红。

entries.shortAnswer: Cupping therapy is 拔罐 in Chinese; people say get cupping therapy for this TCM suction treatment.
entries.definition: cupping therapy (n.): a TCM treatment using suction cups on the skin; common with get/receive, cupping marks.

examples.en: After the marathon, she tried cupping therapy to relieve her tight back muscles, leaving round purple marks on her shoulders.
examples.zh: 马拉松之后，她尝试了拔罐来缓解背部肌肉紧绷，肩上留下了圆圆的紫色罐印。

examples.en: Many people first heard of cupping therapy during the Olympics, when swimmers with circular bruises went viral online.
examples.zh: 很多人第一次听说拔罐是在奥运会期间，当时背上带着圆形瘀印的游泳运动员在网上走红。

entries.shortAnswer: 「副作用」的英文是 side effect，常用复数 side effects。它指药物或治疗在主要疗效之外带来的不良反应，不叫 other effect。
entries.definition: side effect 多指药物、疫苗或治疗引起的身体不良反应，常搭配 have / cause / experience side effects，轻微副作用可说 mild side effects。

examples.en: This medicine may cause mild side effects, such as drowsiness or a dry mouth.
examples.zh: 这种药可能会引起轻微的副作用，比如犯困或口干。

examples.en: Tell your doctor if you have any serious side effects after taking the pills.
examples.zh: 服药后如果出现任何严重的副作用，请告诉你的医生。

entries.shortAnswer: side effect 的中文意思是「副作用」，指药物或治疗主要作用之外的不良反应。它强调附带发生的不良结果，不同于表示次要影响的 byproduct。
entries.definition: side effect 指药物、治疗或某行为在主要效果之外产生的附带（通常不良的）反应，医学语境常与 drug、medication、vaccine 搭配，口语也说 side effects of the medicine。

examples.en: This medicine may cause mild side effects, such as drowsiness or a dry mouth.
examples.zh: 这种药可能会引起轻微的副作用，比如犯困或口干。

examples.en: Tell your doctor if you have any serious side effects after taking the pills.
examples.zh: 服药后如果出现任何严重的副作用，请告诉你的医生。

entries.shortAnswer: 「消炎药」的英文常译作 antibiotics，但严格说这是个俗称误区：antibiotics 是抗生素（杀细菌），而真正的消炎药是 anti-inflammatory drugs，如布洛芬。
entries.definition: 中文口语里的「消炎药」多指抗生素 antibiotics，用于细菌感染，如 take antibiotics 吃抗生素、be on antibiotics 在服抗生素；但医学上消炎药是 anti-inflammatory drugs，用于退烧、消肿、止痛，二者不可混用。

examples.en: The doctor said my infection is bacterial, so he prescribed antibiotics and told me to finish the whole course.
examples.zh: 医生说我的感染是细菌性的，所以开了抗生素，并叮嘱我要吃完整个疗程。

examples.en: Many people take antibiotics for a cold, but that is a common mistake because colds are usually caused by viruses.
examples.zh: 很多人感冒就吃抗生素，但这是个常见错误，因为感冒通常由病毒引起。

entries.shortAnswer: Antibiotics 的中文意思是「抗生素」，中文口语常称为「消炎药」，但严格说消炎药是 anti-inflammatory drugs，如布洛芬。
entries.definition: Antibiotics 指杀灭或抑制细菌的药物，如 take antibiotics 吃抗生素、be on antibiotics 在服抗生素疗程，只对细菌感染有效，不能治普通感冒或病毒；口语中它与中文「消炎药」常被混用，是典型易错点。

examples.en: The doctor said my infection is bacterial, so he prescribed antibiotics and told me to finish the whole course.
examples.zh: 医生说我的感染是细菌性的，所以开了抗生素，并叮嘱我要吃完整个疗程。

examples.en: Many people take antibiotics for a cold, but that is a common mistake because colds are usually caused by viruses.
examples.zh: 很多人感冒就吃抗生素，但这是个常见错误，因为感冒通常由病毒引起。

entries.shortAnswer: 体温计的英文是 thermometer，专指测量体温的仪器，不等于 temperature 温度。
entries.definition: thermometer 是可数名词，常搭配 digital thermometer、ear thermometer；易错点：temperature 指温度或发热，不指仪器。

examples.en: The nurse put a thermometer under my tongue to check my temperature.
examples.zh: 护士把体温计放在我舌头下面量体温。

examples.en: You should buy a digital thermometer so you can monitor your fever at home.
examples.zh: 你应该买个电子体温计，这样在家就能监测发烧情况。

entries.shortAnswer: Thermometer 的中文是体温计，指测量体温的仪器，不等于 temperature 温度本身。
entries.definition: Thermometer is a countable noun; common collocations include digital thermometer and ear thermometer; avoid confusing it with temperature.

examples.en: The nurse put a thermometer under my tongue to check my temperature.
examples.zh: 护士把体温计放在我舌头下面量体温。

examples.en: You should buy a digital thermometer so you can monitor your fever at home.
examples.zh: 你应该买个电子体温计，这样在家就能监测发烧情况。

entries.shortAnswer: 「化验单」的英文是 lab report。在医院抽血、验尿后拿到的那张结果单，英语里最常就说 lab report，不是 test paper。
entries.definition: lab report 指实验室检验后出具的结果报告，如血常规、尿检、肝功能。注意不能译为 test paper（试卷）或 medical certificate（诊断证明）。口语也可说 lab results。

examples.en: The doctor looked at my lab report and said my blood sugar was a little high.
examples.zh: 医生看了我的化验单，说我的血糖有点高。

examples.en: Can you help me understand this lab report? I don't know what these numbers mean.
examples.zh: 你能帮我看看这张化验单吗？我不明白这些数字是什么意思。

entries.shortAnswer: 「lab report」的中文意思是「化验单」，即医院检验后拿到的结果报告。它与 test paper（试卷）不同，强调实验室检测数据的报告单。
entries.definition: lab report 是医院实验室检验（抽血、验尿等）后出具的结果报告，常搭配 get/receive/check a lab report。口语也说 lab results；不要与 test paper（试卷）或 doctor's note（病假条）混淆。

examples.en: The doctor looked at my lab report and said my blood sugar was a little high.
examples.zh: 医生看了我的化验单，说我的血糖有点高。

examples.en: Can you help me understand this lab report? I don't know what these numbers mean.
examples.zh: 你能帮我看看这张化验单吗？我不明白这些数字是什么意思。

entries.shortAnswer: 量血压的英文是 blood pressure，常用搭配 take one's blood pressure，注意它指血压数值，测量动作要加 take 或 check。
entries.definition: 量血压英语说 take 或 check someone's blood pressure。blood pressure 是名词，指血压数值，不能当动词用，别说 blood pressure me。

examples.en: The nurse took my blood pressure before the doctor came in.
examples.zh: 医生进来之前，护士给我量了血压。

examples.en: If you often feel dizzy, you should check your blood pressure regularly.
examples.zh: 如果你经常感到头晕，应该定期量血压。

entries.shortAnswer: blood pressure 的中文意思是血压，中文常说量血压，即 take one's blood pressure，它指血压数值本身。
entries.definition: blood pressure 指血液对血管壁的压力，常见搭配 take/check one's blood pressure、high/low blood pressure，不可直接作动词。

examples.en: The nurse took my blood pressure before the doctor came in.
examples.zh: 医生进来之前，护士给我量了血压。

examples.en: If you often feel dizzy, you should check your blood pressure regularly.
examples.zh: 如果你经常感到头晕，应该定期量血压。

entries.shortAnswer: 「取钱」的英文是 withdraw money。最常用搭配是 withdraw money from the bank/ATM，表示从银行或自动取款机取出现金。
entries.definition: withdraw money 指从银行账户中取出现金，是正式说法；口语中也可说 get/take out money。注意 withdraw 是及物动词，后面直接接钱，不说 withdraw from the bank money。

examples.en: I need to withdraw money from the ATM before the store closes.
examples.zh: 商店关门前，我需要去自动取款机取钱。

examples.en: She withdrew money from her savings account to pay for the trip.
examples.zh: 她从储蓄账户里取了钱来支付旅行费用。

entries.shortAnswer: “withdraw money”的中文意思是“取钱”，指从银行账户取出现金。和“deposit money（存钱）”相对，比“take out money”更正式。
entries.definition: withdraw money 表示从银行账户中取出现金，常用于银行、ATM 等场合。名词形式为 withdrawal。注意 withdraw 是及物动词，直接跟宾语，如 withdraw money from the bank。

examples.en: I need to withdraw money from the ATM before the store closes.
examples.zh: 商店关门前，我需要去自动取款机取钱。

examples.en: She withdrew money from her savings account to pay for the trip.
examples.zh: 她从储蓄账户里取了钱来支付旅行费用。

entries.shortAnswer: 「存钱」的英文是 deposit money。注意：deposit money 指把钱存入银行账户；若想表达「攒钱」，用 save money 更准确。
entries.definition: deposit money 强调将现金存入银行账户的动作，常与 into 连用，如 deposit money into a bank account。日常口语中也可省略 money，直接说 deposit a check。

examples.en: I need to deposit money into my savings account before the bank closes.
examples.zh: 我需要在银行关门前把钱存进储蓄账户。

examples.en: She deposits money at the ATM every Friday to avoid service fees.
examples.zh: 她每周五都在自动取款机存钱，以避免手续费。

entries.shortAnswer: “deposit money”的中文意思是「存钱」。它特指把钱存入银行账户，而 save money 侧重攒钱，不涉及银行动作。
entries.definition: deposit money 表示将资金存入银行账户，属正式/银行业用语，搭配为 deposit money into an account。注意与 withdraw money（取钱）互为反义，避免与 remit money（汇款）混淆。

examples.en: I need to deposit money into my savings account before the bank closes.
examples.zh: 我需要在银行关门前把钱存进储蓄账户。

examples.en: She deposits money at the ATM every Friday to avoid service fees.
examples.zh: 她每周五都在自动取款机存钱，以避免手续费。

entries.shortAnswer: 转账的英文是 transfer money，指在账户间转移资金。注意与 remit money 区别：后者多指跨境汇款，而 transfer money 更通用。
entries.definition: transfer money 泛指银行或电子账户间转移资金，可搭配 bank transfer、wire transfer；与 remit money（跨境汇款）不同，后者强调汇往异地或境外且常涉及手续费。

examples.en: I need to transfer money to my landlord before the rent is due.
examples.zh: 我需要在房租到期前给房东转账。

examples.en: You can transfer money internationally through a wire transfer, but the bank charges a service fee.
examples.zh: 你可以通过电汇进行国际转账，但银行会收取手续费。

entries.shortAnswer: transfer money 的中文意思是转账，指在账户间转移资金。它比 remit money 更通用，后者特指跨境汇款。
entries.definition: transfer money 表示在银行或电子账户间转移资金，常用于日常转账、手机银行操作；与 remit money（跨境汇款）不同，后者更正式且涉及跨境。

examples.en: I need to transfer money to my landlord before the rent is due.
examples.zh: 我需要在房租到期前给房东转账。

examples.en: You can transfer money internationally through a wire transfer, but the bank charges a service fee.
examples.zh: 你可以通过电汇进行国际转账，但银行会收取手续费。

entries.shortAnswer: 「止痛药」的英文是 painkiller，属于日常口语和药品标签都常用的词。注意它多指非处方类止痛片，医院里的强效镇痛药常用 analgesic。
entries.definition: painkiller 是可数名词，常说 take a painkiller（吃止痛药），搭配 take 而不是 eat；也有 painkiller 作定语，如 painkiller tablet。复数为 painkillers。美式口语还常用 pain reliever。

examples.en: I have a bad headache, so I'm going to take a painkiller.
examples.zh: 我头疼得厉害，打算吃一片止痛药。

examples.en: These painkillers work quickly, but you shouldn't take them on an empty stomach.
examples.zh: 这些止痛药见效很快，但不应该空腹服用。

entries.shortAnswer: Painkiller 的中文意思是「止痛药」，指缓解疼痛的药物。它偏日常和药品标签用语，医学语境里更强效的镇痛药多用 analgesic。
entries.definition: painkiller 为可数名词，口语中常说 take a painkiller（吃止痛药），搭配动词 take 而非 eat。常见搭配有 a strong/mild painkiller、over-the-counter painkiller；复数是 painkillers。

examples.en: I have a bad headache, so I'm going to take a painkiller.
examples.zh: 我头疼得厉害，打算吃一片止痛药。

examples.en: These painkillers work quickly, but you shouldn't take them on an empty stomach.
examples.zh: 这些止痛药见效很快，但不应该空腹服用。

entries.shortAnswer: 「汇款」的英文是 remit money，指通过银行把钱汇往异地或境外，比 transfer money 更正式。
entries.definition: remit money 指通过银行或金融机构汇款，常搭配 remit money to sb、abroad，比 transfer 更正式。

examples.en: I need to remit money to my family in China every month.
examples.zh: 我每个月都需要给在中国的家人汇款。

examples.en: The bank charges a service fee to remit money overseas.
examples.zh: 银行对境外汇款收取手续费。

entries.shortAnswer: “remit money”的中文意思是「汇款」，指通过银行把钱汇出，尤其用于跨境或异地，比 transfer money 正式。
entries.definition: remit money 意为汇款，指通过银行等把钱寄给他人，常用于跨境场景，搭配 remit money to sb。

examples.en: I need to remit money to my family in China every month.
examples.zh: 我每个月都需要给在中国的家人汇款。

examples.en: The bank charges a service fee to remit money overseas.
examples.zh: 银行对境外汇款收取手续费。

entries.shortAnswer: 现金的英文是 cash。注意 cash 通常指纸币和硬币，强调即时支付；与 card（刷卡）相对，取钱常说 withdraw cash。
entries.definition: cash 多指实体货币，常用于 pay in cash（现金支付）、withdraw cash（取现）、cash on delivery（货到付款）。易错：check 是支票，credit 是赊账，均非现金。

examples.en: Do you want to pay in cash or by card?
examples.zh: 您想付现金还是刷卡？

examples.en: I need to withdraw some cash from the ATM before dinner.
examples.zh: 晚饭前我需要从自动取款机取些现金。

entries.shortAnswer: cash 的中文意思是现金。它指纸币和硬币，与信用卡、支票等支付方式相对，强调立刻支付。
entries.definition: cash 作名词时指现钞，常见搭配：in cash（用现金）、cash machine（取款机）、cashier（收银员）。作动词可表兑现，如 cash a check。口语中也泛指钱。

examples.en: Do you want to pay in cash or by card?
examples.zh: 您想付现金还是刷卡？

examples.en: I need to withdraw some cash from the ATM before dinner.
examples.zh: 晚饭前我需要从自动取款机取些现金。

entries.shortAnswer: 「刷卡」的英文是 pay by card，指用银行卡付款。注意它强调付款方式，若特指刷信用卡可说 pay by credit card。
entries.definition: pay by card 是「用银行卡付款」的通用说法，口语和书面都常用；同类搭配还有 pay in cash（付现金）、pay by phone（手机支付）。若想强调刷卡这个动作，也可说 swipe the card，但如今插卡和感应支付更常见。

examples.en: Can I pay by card here, or do you only take cash?
examples.zh: 这里可以刷卡吗，还是只收现金？

examples.en: She paid by card at the supermarket and kept the receipt for the record.
examples.zh: 她在超市刷了卡，并留下小票备查。

entries.shortAnswer: pay by card 的中文意思是「刷卡」，指用银行卡而非现金付款。它只说明付款方式，不涉及具体是借记卡还是信用卡。
entries.definition: pay by card 指以银行卡完成支付，常见于收银台、餐厅、网购等场景；正式场合也说 pay by credit/debit card。与 pay in cash 相对，不强调刷的动作，插卡、感应支付都算。

examples.en: Can I pay by card here, or do you only take cash?
examples.zh: 这里可以刷卡吗，还是只收现金？

examples.en: She paid by card at the supermarket and kept the receipt for the record.
examples.zh: 她在超市刷了卡，并留下小票备查。

entries.shortAnswer: 存折的英文是 passbook。注意，passbook 特指银行纸质储蓄本，而 bankbook 更老式，日常说银行账户一般用 bank account。
entries.definition: passbook 常见搭配：update the passbook（补登存折）、passbook savings account（存折储蓄账户）。存钱、取钱、转账时银行可能要求出示存折。与 debit card（借记卡）不同，passbook 是纸质记录本。

examples.en: I need to update my passbook at the bank to see the latest transactions.
examples.zh: 我需要去银行补登存折，看看最新的交易记录。

examples.en: She deposited money into her passbook savings account and checked the exchange rate for a transfer.
examples.zh: 她把钱存入了存折储蓄账户，并查看了转账的汇率。

entries.shortAnswer: Passbook 的中文意思是存折。它指银行发给储户的纸质小本，用于记录存款、取款和利息，区别于 bank statement（对账单）和 debit card。
entries.definition: Passbook 是纸质储蓄记录本，常见搭配：passbook savings account（存折储蓄账户）、update your passbook（补登存折）。在柜台存钱、取钱、转账时使用。注意：现在多用 bank statement 或手机银行，passbook 偏传统。

examples.en: I need to update my passbook at the bank to see the latest transactions.
examples.zh: 我需要去银行补登存折，看看最新的交易记录。

examples.en: She deposited money into her passbook savings account and checked the exchange rate for a transfer.
examples.zh: 她把钱存入了存折储蓄账户，并查看了转账的汇率。

entries.shortAnswer: 「退烧」的英文是 reduce fever，例如：吃药退烧 take medicine to reduce fever，更口语的说法是 bring down the fever。
entries.definition: reduce fever 强调降低体温、把烧退下去，常用于吃药、打针等就医用药场景；bring down the fever 更口语，英式也常用 bring the fever down。

examples.en: The doctor told me to take this medicine to reduce fever.
examples.zh: 医生让我吃这种药来退烧。

examples.en: You should drink plenty of water and get some rest to help reduce fever.
examples.zh: 你应该多喝水、多休息，这样有助于退烧。

entries.shortAnswer: 「reduce fever」的中文意思是「退烧」，指把发烧的体温降下来，比 bring down the fever 稍正式，常用于药物或治疗。
entries.definition: reduce fever 是动词短语，表示退烧、降低体温，常与 medicine、drugs、treatment 搭配，如 take medicine to reduce fever，口语更常说 bring down the fever。

examples.en: The doctor told me to take this medicine to reduce fever.
examples.zh: 医生让我吃这种药来退烧。

examples.en: You should drink plenty of water and get some rest to help reduce fever.
examples.zh: 你应该多喝水、多休息，这样有助于退烧。

entries.shortAnswer: 银行卡的英文是 bank card，指银行发行的用于存取款、转账或支付的塑料卡片。注意 bank card 常特指借记卡，而信用卡更常说 credit card。
entries.definition: bank card 是统称，包括借记卡 debit card 和信用卡 credit card。常见搭配：use a bank card、insert your bank card、bank card number。在英式英语中，bank card 有时也泛指银行卡。

examples.en: I need to withdraw some money from the ATM, but I forgot my bank card at home.
examples.zh: 我需要从自动取款机取点钱，但把银行卡忘在家里了。

examples.en: You can pay by bank card, but there is a small transaction fee for credit cards.
examples.zh: 你可以用银行卡支付，但信用卡会收取少量手续费。

entries.shortAnswer: bank card 的中文意思是银行卡，即银行发行的用于取款、存款或支付的卡片。它通常指借记卡，区别于 credit card（信用卡）。
entries.definition: bank card 是通用术语，可指借记卡或信用卡。常见搭配：pay by bank card、bank card details、swipe your bank card。口语中常说 card，但正式场合用 bank card 更明确。

examples.en: I need to withdraw some money from the ATM, but I forgot my bank card at home.
examples.zh: 我需要从自动取款机取点钱，但把银行卡忘在家里了。

examples.en: You can pay by bank card, but there is a small transaction fee for credit cards.
examples.zh: 你可以用银行卡支付，但信用卡会收取少量手续费。

entries.shortAnswer: 「信用卡」的英文是 credit card，指银行发行的可先消费后还款的支付卡。注意它与借记卡 debit card 不同，后者直接从账户扣款。
entries.definition: credit card 是可数名词，常与 apply for（申请）、use（使用）、pay off（还清）等动词搭配。申请说 apply for a credit card，刷卡付款说 pay by credit card。

examples.en: Can I pay by credit card, or do you only accept cash?
examples.zh: 我可以刷信用卡支付吗，还是你们只收现金？

examples.en: She applied for a new credit card with a lower interest rate.
examples.zh: 她申请了一张利率更低的新信用卡。

entries.shortAnswer: credit card 的中文意思是「信用卡」，一种由银行发行的、允许先消费后还款的支付卡。它与借记卡 debit card 不同，后者直接从银行账户扣款。
entries.definition: credit card 常指银行或金融机构发行的塑料支付卡，可透支消费并需按期还款。常见搭配有 apply for a credit card、pay by credit card、max out a credit card。

examples.en: Can I pay by credit card, or do you only accept cash?
examples.zh: 我可以刷信用卡支付吗，还是你们只收现金？

examples.en: She applied for a new credit card with a lower interest rate.
examples.zh: 她申请了一张利率更低的新信用卡。

entries.shortAnswer: “充值”用英语说是 top up，常用于给手机、交通卡或账户充值。注意 top up 强调补足余额，不是“转账”（transfer）。
entries.definition: top up 多用于英式英语，搭配 top up your phone／card／account。给手机充话费可说 top up my phone。与 deposit（往银行存钱）、transfer（转账）不同，top up 侧重把余额补满。

examples.en: I need to top up my phone before the trip.
examples.zh: 旅行前我得给手机充点话费。

examples.en: You can top up your transport card at any station.
examples.zh: 你可以在任何车站给交通卡充值。

entries.shortAnswer: top up 的中文意思是“充值”，指给手机、交通卡或账户补充余额。它与 deposit 不同，deposit 是往银行存钱，而 top up 强调补足已有余额。
entries.definition: top up 在英式英语中很常见，如 top up your phone、top up your account。表示给账户补钱或续费，口语和日常场合常用；美式英语更常说 refill 或 add money。名词形式为 a top-up。

examples.en: I need to top up my phone before the trip.
examples.zh: 旅行前我得给手机充点话费。

examples.en: You can top up your transport card at any station.
examples.zh: 你可以在任何车站给交通卡充值。

entries.shortAnswer: 汇率用英语说是 exchange rate，就是两种货币兑换的比率，常见于银行换汇和跨境汇款，别和利率搞混。
entries.definition: exchange rate 指一国货币兑换另一国货币的比率，常见搭配有 current exchange rate、exchange rate fluctuation。银行换汇、跨境汇款都离不开它，别和 interest rate（利率）混淆。

examples.en: The exchange rate between the dollar and the yuan has changed a lot this year.
examples.zh: 今年美元兑人民币的汇率变化很大。

examples.en: Before you transfer money abroad, check the exchange rate and any service fees.
examples.zh: 跨境汇款前，先查一下汇率和手续费。

entries.shortAnswer: Exchange rate 就是“汇率”，指两种货币之间的兑换比率，不是利率，也不是普通比率，常见于银行换汇。
entries.definition: exchange rate 指两种货币兑换的比率，常见搭配有 foreign exchange rate、fixed/floating exchange rate。多用于银行、外汇和跨境汇款场景，注意与 interest rate（利率）区分。

examples.en: The exchange rate between the dollar and the yuan has changed a lot this year.
examples.zh: 今年美元兑人民币的汇率变化很大。

examples.en: Before you transfer money abroad, check the exchange rate and any service fees.
examples.zh: 跨境汇款前，先查一下汇率和手续费。

entries.shortAnswer: 「零钱」的英文是 small change，指随身携带的少量硬币或小额钞票。注意 give change 才是「找零」，别把零钱说成 change money。
entries.definition: small change 强调金额小、面额零散的现金，多指硬币或零钞；统称「零钱」还可用 loose change。与找零 give change（keep the change 意为不用找了）不同，deposit money 是存钱，withdraw money 是取钱。

examples.en: I always keep some small change in my pocket for the bus.
examples.zh: 我口袋里总放着一些零钱，用来坐公交车。

examples.en: Could you give me small change for a ten-yuan note?
examples.zh: 你能把这张十元纸币换成零钱给我吗？

entries.shortAnswer: small change 的中文意思是零钱，即少量的硬币或小面额钞票。它强调金额小，不等于中文常说的「找零」，找零在英文里是 give change。
entries.definition: small change 指随身携带的零散硬币或小额钞票，多用于口语，常见搭配 have some small change、for small change。注意与 change 表「找回的钱」的用法区分，大额换零可用 break a bill。

examples.en: I always keep some small change in my pocket for the bus.
examples.zh: 我口袋里总放着一些零钱，用来坐公交车。

examples.en: Could you give me small change for a ten-yuan note?
examples.zh: 你能把这张十元纸币换成零钱给我吗？

entries.shortAnswer: 「找零」的英文是 give change，指收钱后把多出的余额退还顾客。注意 give change 强调退钱动作，而 change 单独作名词才表示零钱本身。
entries.definition: give change 是收银、乘车、集市等现金交易中的常用说法，常搭配 give sb change 或 give change for sth。若想表达不用找零，英语固定说 keep the change，不能说 no change。

examples.en: The cashier gave me change for a twenty-dollar bill.
examples.zh: 收银员给了我一张二十美元钞票的找零。

examples.en: Keep the change, and thank you for your help.
examples.zh: 不用找零了，谢谢你的帮助。

entries.shortAnswer: give change 的中文意思是「找零」，即把顾客多付的金额退还给他。它与 change 作名词时表示零钱不同，give change 强调的是找钱这个动作。
entries.definition: give change 用于现金付款场合，搭配 give sb change、give change for a note。口语中 keep the change 表示不用找了；注意 extend 和 transfer 等词与找零无关。

examples.en: The cashier gave me change for a twenty-dollar bill.
examples.zh: 收银员给了我一张二十美元钞票的找零。

examples.en: Keep the change, and thank you for your help.
examples.zh: 不用找零了，谢谢你的帮助。

entries.shortAnswer: 「借钱」的英文是 borrow money，指从别人那里借入钱款。注意：borrow 是「借入」，不是「借出」，「借出」要用 lend。
entries.definition: borrow money 表示「借入钱」，常见搭配：borrow money from a bank（向银行借钱）、borrow money from a friend（向朋友借钱）。易错点：borrow 是借进来，lend 是借出去，方向相反，不要混用。

examples.en: I had to borrow money from my parents to pay the deposit on the apartment.
examples.zh: 我不得不向父母借钱来付公寓的押金。

examples.en: If you borrow money from the bank, remember to check the interest rate and service fees first.
examples.zh: 如果你向银行借钱，记得先查看利率和手续费。

entries.shortAnswer: borrow money 的中文意思是「借钱」，即从别人处借入钱款。它强调借入方向，与 lend money（把钱借给别人）正好相反。
entries.definition: borrow money 表示向他人或机构借入钱款，常与 from 连用：borrow money from the bank。口语和正式场合均可用；注意不要与 lend money（借出钱）混淆。

examples.en: I had to borrow money from my parents to pay the deposit on the apartment.
examples.zh: 我不得不向父母借钱来付公寓的押金。

examples.en: If you borrow money from the bank, remember to check the interest rate and service fees first.
examples.zh: 如果你向银行借钱，记得先查看利率和手续费。

entries.shortAnswer: 「账户」的英文是 account，如银行账户 bank account；也可指网络账号、账目或解释，需按语境判断。
entries.definition: account 指账户，如开账户 open an account、账户余额 account balance、储蓄账户 savings account。

examples.en: I opened a savings account at the bank to save money for a new car.
examples.zh: 我在银行开了一个储蓄账户，用来存钱买新车。

examples.en: Please transfer the money to my account and tell me the transaction fee.
examples.zh: 请把钱转到我的账户，并告诉我手续费。

entries.shortAnswer: account 的中文意思是「账户」，指银行账户或网络账号，也可表示账目、客户或解释。
entries.definition: account 在金钱银行场景指账户，如 open an account 开账户、account balance 账户余额、savings account 储蓄账户。
